words.ex: He learned a new technique to paint better.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一种新的绘画技术。
words.en: A technique is a particular method of doing an activity, usually a method that involves practical skills.

words.tr: adj. 有缺陷的；有故障的；有错误的；
words.ex: The faulty phone keeps turning off.
words.ex_cn: 这部有缺陷的手机总是自动关机。
words.en: If you describe something as faulty, you mean that it is not perfect or it has some weaknesses.

words.ex: He abbreviates the word 'example' as 'ex.'.
words.ex_cn: 他把单词 'example' 缩写为 'ex.'。
words.en: To abbreviate something means to make it shorter, especially by using a particular word or phrase to represent it.

words.ex: The cut on his finger turned into an abscess.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口变成了脓肿。
words.en: An abscess is a painful collection of pus, usually caused by a bacterial infection.

words.ex: He practices abstinence from alcohol.
words.ex_cn: 他戒酒。
words.en: The practice of restraining oneself from indulging in something, typically alcohol or sex.

words.ex: The house abuts the park.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子紧邻公园。
words.en: If one thing abuts another, it is next to it or touches it at one end.

words.ex: He is an academician at the national academy.
words.ex_cn: 他是国家科学院的院士。
words.en: An academician is a member of an academy, especially of an academy of arts or sciences.

words.ex: He plays the accordion at the street festival.
words.ex_cn: 他在街头音乐节上演奏手风琴。
words.en: An accordion is a musical instrument that you play by pressing keys or buttons on one side and pulling and pushing a bellows on the other side to force air through reeds, producing notes.

words.ex: The school received accreditation from the government.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校获得了政府的认可。
words.en: Accreditation is the act of granting credit or recognition, especially to an educational institution that maintains suitable standards.

words.ex: He has achromatopsia and sees only in gray.
words.ex_cn: 他患有色盲，只能看到灰色。
words.en: Achromatopsia is a medical condition that results in the inability to perceive color, causing affected individuals to see only in shades of gray.

words.ex: He has acidosis because his kidneys are not working well.
words.ex_cn: 他患有酸中毒，因为他的肾脏功能不好。
words.en: A condition in which there is too much acid in the body fluids; it is the opposite of alkalosis.

words.ex: He has acne on his face.
words.ex_cn: 他脸上有痤疮。
words.en: Acne is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells. It often causes whiteheads, blackheads or pimples, and usually appears on the face, forehead, chest, upper back and shoulders.

words.ex: The room has good acoustic properties.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有良好的声音效果。
words.en: Relating to sound or the sense of hearing.

words.ex: NASA is an acronym for National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
words.ex_cn: NASA 是美国国家航空航天局的缩写。
words.en: An acronym is a word formed from the initial letters of the words in a phrase, especially when this is used as a name.

words.ex: He feels dizzy because of his acrophobia when he looks down from the tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他从高楼往下看时因为恐高而感到头晕。
words.en: An extreme or irrational fear of heights.

words.ex: The children visited the ancient acropolis on a school trip.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在一次学校旅行中参观了古老的卫城。
words.en: An acropolis is a large hill in the center of a city, on which were built important buildings, especially in ancient Greece.

words.ex: He tried acupuncture to relieve his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他尝试针刺疗法来缓解背痛。
words.en: Acupuncture is a form of treatment that involves inserting very thin needles through a person's skin at specific points on the body, to various depths, for therapeutic purposes.

words.ex: He was adamant about not changing his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他坚定不移地不改变主意。
words.en: If someone is adamant about something, they are determined not to change their mind about it.

words.ex: This food contains a harmless additive for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有用于调味的无害添加物。
words.en: An additive is a substance which is added in small amounts to something else in order to improve it, preserve it, or make it more effective.

words.tr:
n. 附属物；
adj. 附属的；
words.ex: The printer is an adjunct to the computer.
words.ex_cn: 打印机是电脑的附属物。
words.en: Something that is added or attached to something else but is not essential to it.

words.ex: The teacher gave him an admonition for being late.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为他迟到而给了他一个警告。
words.en: An admonition is a warning or a piece of advice that is given to someone to correct their behavior or to prevent them from doing something wrong.

words.tr: n. 风干土坯；风干砖坯；
words.ex: The old house was built with adobe bricks.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子是用风干土坯砖建造的。
words.en: Adobe is a natural building material made from sand, clay, water, and some kind of fibrous or organic material (sticks, straw, and/or manure), which the builders shape into bricks using frames and dry in the sun.

words.ex: He was shy during his adolescence.
words.ex_cn: 他在青春期时很害羞。
words.en: Adolescence is the period in a person's life when they develop from a child into an adult.

words.ex: He felt adrenaline when he jumped from the plane.
words.ex_cn: 当他从飞机上跳下时，感受到了肾上腺素。
words.en: A hormone secreted by the adrenal glands, especially in conditions of stress, increasing rates of blood circulation, breathing, and carbohydrate metabolism and preparing muscles for exertion.

words.ex: He adulterates milk with water to make more money.
words.ex_cn: 他往牛奶里加水以赚更多钱。
words.en: To make something poorer in quality by adding another substance to it.

words.ex: He used an adz to shape the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用锛刀来加工木材。
words.en: A tool similar to an axe, used for cutting or shaping wood.

words.tr:
n. 扁斧
v. 以扁斧劈
words.ex: He used an adze to shape the wooden boat.
words.ex_cn: 他用斧凿来塑造木船。
words.en: An adze is a tool similar to an axe, used for cutting or shaping wood.

words.tr: adj. 需氧的；好氧的；有氧的；
words.ex: Running is an aerobic exercise.
words.ex_cn: 跑步是有氧运动。
words.en: Aerobic exercise is physical exercise of relatively low intensity that depends primarily on the aerobic energy-generating process.

words.tr: n. 空气动力学；气体力学
words.ex: The car's shape improves aerodynamics.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的形状改善了空气动力学性能。
words.en: Aerodynamics is the study of how gases interact with moving bodies. Because the gas that we encounter most is air, aerodynamics is primarily concerned with the forces of drag and lift, which are caused by air passing over and around solid bodies.

words.ex: He works in the aerospace industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在航空航天行业工作。
words.en: The branch of technology and industry concerned with both aviation and space flight.

words.ex: The painting has a simple aesthetic appeal.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种简单的审美吸引力。
words.en: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.

words.ex: He is afebrile after taking the medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他吃药后没有发烧。
words.en: not having a fever; without fever

words.ex: The afferent nerve carries signals to the brain.
words.ex_cn: 传入神经将信号传递到大脑。
words.en: An afferent nerve fiber or vessel carries impulses or fluid towards a central organ or point of reference.

words.tr: n. 喜爱；类同；密切关系；亲和力
words.ex: She has an affinity for painting.
words.ex_cn: 她喜爱绘画。
words.en: A natural liking for or attraction to someone or something.

words.ex: He believes in an afterlife where people meet again.
words.ex_cn: 他相信人死后会进入一个再次相聚的来世。
words.en: The afterlife is the belief that a part of, or essence of, or soul of an individual, which carries with it and may confer personal identity, survives the death of the body of this world and this lifetime, according to various worldviews.

words.tr: n. 对老年人的歧视；年龄歧视
words.ex: He faced ageism when he applied for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他申请工作时遭遇了年龄歧视。
words.en: Ageism is prejudice or discrimination on the grounds of a person's age.

words.ex: He believes in agnosticism and says he doesn't know if God exists.
words.ex_cn: 他相信不可知论，说他不知道上帝是否存在。
words.en: Agnosticism is the belief that it is not possible to know whether God exists or not.

words.tr: n. 广场恐惧症；旷野恐怖症
words.ex: He has agoraphobia and avoids crowded places.
words.ex_cn: 他患有广场恐惧症，避免去拥挤的地方。
words.en: Agoraphobia is an anxiety disorder characterized by an intense fear of being in situations from which escape might be difficult or embarrassing, or in which help may not be available in the event of a panic attack.

words.ex: He had an ague last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天他得了寒热病。
words.en: A fever or shivering fit, especially one caused by malaria.

words.ex: An air mass is a large body of air with generally uniform temperature and humidity.
words.ex_cn: 气团是一个温度和湿度大致均匀的大气团。
words.en: An air mass is a large volume of air in the atmosphere that is mostly uniform in temperature and moisture.

words.tr: adj. 飞行的；空运的；空中传播的；
words.ex: The airborne soldiers jumped from the plane.
words.ex_cn: 这些空降士兵从飞机上跳下。
words.en: In the air; flying or transported by air.

words.tr:
adj. 半开的；微启的
adv. 微开地；半开地
words.ex: The door was ajar so I pushed it open.
words.ex_cn: 门半开着，所以我推开了它。
words.en: If a door is ajar, it is slightly open.

words.ex: The alchemist tried to turn lead into gold.
words.ex_cn: 炼金术士试图把铅变成黄金。
words.en: An alchemist is a person who studies or practices alchemy, which was a form of chemistry and speculative philosophy practiced in the Middle Ages and the Renaissance, concerned principally with discovering methods for transmuting baser metals into gold and with finding a universal solvent and an elixir of life.

words.ex: He is learning alchemy from an old book.
words.ex_cn: 他正从一本旧书中学习炼金术。
words.en: Alchemy is an ancient practice that aimed to transform base metals into gold and to discover a universal cure for disease and a way of extending life.

words.ex: The pond is full of green alga.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里充满了绿色的藻类。
words.en: A simple, nonflowering, and typically aquatic plant of a large group that includes the seaweeds and many single-celled forms. Algae contain chlorophyll but lack true stems, roots, leaves, and vascular tissue.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.ex: The engineer checked the alignment of the wheels.
words.ex_cn: 工程师检查了车轮的对齐。
words.en: The arrangement of something in a straight line or in correct relative positions.

words.ex: Lye is a strong alkali used in cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种用于清洁的强碱。
words.en: An alkali is a chemical compound that neutralizes acids to form salts and turns red litmus paper blue.

words.ex: Morphine is an alkaloid derived from opium.
words.ex_cn: 吗啡是从鸦片中提取的一种生物碱。
words.en: An alkaloid is a naturally occurring chemical compound containing basic nitrogen atoms. This group also includes some related compounds with neutral and even weakly acidic properties. Some synthetic compounds of similar structure may also be termed alkaloids.

words.ex: The story is an allegory about kindness.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事是一个关于善良的寓言。
words.en: An allegory is a story, poem, or picture which can be interpreted to reveal a hidden meaning, typically a moral or political one.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.tr: v. 结盟；“ally”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: Two countries allied to fight the common enemy.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家结盟以对抗共同的敌人。
words.en: Allied means joined by or relating to members of an alliance.

words.ex: The big black bug bit the brave boy.
words.ex_cn: 大黑虫咬了勇敢的男孩。
words.en: Alliteration is the occurrence of the same letter or sound at the beginning of adjacent or closely connected words.

words.ex: The allottee was notified of the land allocation.
words.ex_cn: 这位被分配者被通知了土地分配的消息。
words.en: A person to whom something is allotted, especially land or shares.

words.tr:
n. 合金
v. 把…铸成合金
words.ex: He made a strong alloy from copper and zinc.
words.ex_cn: 他用铜和锌制造了一种坚固的合金。
words.en: An alloy is a metal made by combining two or more metallic elements, especially to give greater strength or resistance to corrosion.

words.tr: adj. 暗指的；引用典故的
words.ex: His poem is allusive, referring to old myths.
words.ex_cn: 他的诗含蓄，暗指古老的神话。
words.en: If you describe something as allusive, you mean that it contains or makes use of indirect references or suggestions.

words.ex: God is almighty and can do anything.
words.ex_cn: 上帝是全能的，能做任何事。
words.en: The Almighty is used to refer to God. It can also describe something that has very great power or influence.

words.ex: The almshouse provided shelter for the elderly and needy.
words.ex_cn: 这所公立救济院为老人和穷人提供了庇护。
words.en: An almshouse is a house founded by charity, offering accommodation for the poor or elderly.

words.ex: The bird flew aloft above the trees.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在树顶上方高飞。
words.en: If something is aloft, it is in the air or off the ground.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: He is an alumnus of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的男毕业生。
words.en: An alumnus is a former student of a particular school, college, or university.

words.tr:
adj. 齿槽的；齿龈的；肺泡的
n. 齿龈音
words.ex: The alveolar sounds are produced with the tongue against or close to the ridge behind the upper teeth.
words.ex_cn: 齿龈音是通过舌头抵住或靠近上牙后部的齿龈产生的。
words.en: Relating to the alveoli of the lungs or the sockets of the teeth.

words.ex: The alveoli in the lungs are crucial for gas exchange.
words.ex_cn: 肺中的肺泡对气体交换至关重要。
words.en: Tiny air sacs within the lungs where the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide takes place.

words.ex: The alveolus is the bony socket that holds the tooth in the jaw.
words.ex_cn: 牙槽是颚骨中固定牙齿的骨窝。
words.en: A small cavity, pit, or hollow, in particular.

words.ex: She wore a necklace made of amber.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一条琥珀制成的项链。
words.en: Amber is a hard, translucent, yellowish-brown substance that is used for making jewelry or other objects. It is formed from the resin of ancient trees.

words.ex: He felt ambivalent about accepting the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他对接受这份工作邀约感到矛盾。
words.en: If you say that someone is ambivalent about something, you mean that they have mixed feelings about it or are unsure whether they want it or not.

words.ex: The ambulant patient walks to the clinic every day.
words.ex_cn: 这位能行走的病人每天步行去诊所。
words.en: Capable of walking or moving about; not confined to bed.

words.ex: Proteins are made of amino acids.
words.ex_cn: 蛋白质由氨基酸组成。
words.en: Relating to or containing an amino group, which is a functional group consisting of a nitrogen atom attached by single bonds to hydrogen atoms.

words.tr:
adv. 有毛病地；出差错地；不合适地
adj. 有毛病的；出差错的；不合适的
words.ex: Something is amiss with the machine.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器有些不对劲。
words.en: If something is amiss, there is something wrong.

words.ex: Ammonia has a strong smell.
words.ex_cn: 氨有一种刺鼻的气味。
words.en: Ammonia is a colorless gas with a characteristic pungent smell. It is used in the manufacture of fertilizers and as a refrigerant.

words.ex: He has amnesia and cannot remember his name.
words.ex_cn: 他患有失忆症，想不起自己的名字。
words.en: Amnesia is a medical condition that affects someone's memory and they are unable to remember events or information.

words.ex: The food was amply provided for all guests.
words.ex_cn: 所有客人的食物都充足地提供了。
words.en: If something is amply demonstrated, proved, or rewarded, it is shown, proven, or rewarded in a very obvious and satisfactory way.

words.ex: The doctor had to amputate his leg after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，医生不得不截去他的腿。
words.en: To amputate someone's arm or leg means to cut all or part of it off in a medical operation.

words.tr: n. 变位词（相同字母异序词）
words.ex: He solved the anagram quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解出了这个字谜。
words.en: An anagram is a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of a different word or phrase, typically using all the original letters exactly once.

words.ex: The two situations are analogous.
words.ex_cn: 这两种情况是相似的。
words.en: If one thing is analogous to another, the two things are similar in some way.

words.ex: This old phone is an analogue of the new smartphone.
words.ex_cn: 这部旧手机是这款智能手机的类似物。
words.en: Something that is similar to another thing in design, origin, use, etc., but not exactly the same.

words.tr:
n. 无政府主义者
adj. 信奉无政府主义的
words.ex: He is an anarchist who hates all governments.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名无政府主义者，憎恨所有政府。
words.en: An anarchist is a person who believes in or tries to bring about anarchy.

words.ex: The students learned the anatomy of the human heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们学习了人类心脏的解剖组织构造。
words.en: Anatomy is the study of the structure of the bodies of people or animals.

words.ex: He learned about his ancestry from his grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖母那里了解了自己的血统。
words.en: Your ancestry is the series of ancestors from whom you are descended.

words.ex: His argument is based on anecdotal evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点基于轶事证据。
words.en: Anecdotal evidence is based on personal accounts rather than on research that can be verified.

words.ex: He feels weak because he has anemia.
words.ex_cn: 他感到虚弱，因为他患有贫血。
words.en: A condition in which there is a deficiency of red cells or of haemoglobin in the blood, resulting in pallor and weariness.

words.ex: The doctor gave him anesthesia before the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生在手术前给他打了麻醉。
words.en: Anesthesia is the use of drugs to prevent pain during surgery or other medical procedures.

words.tr:
n. 麻醉剂；麻醉药
adj. 麻醉的
words.ex: The doctor gave him an anesthetic before the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生在手术前给他用了麻醉剂。
words.en: An anesthetic is a substance that causes loss of sensation or consciousness, used especially to prevent pain during medical procedures.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.ex: The lab uses anhydrous ethanol for experiments.
words.ex_cn: 实验室使用无水乙醇进行实验。
words.en: Anhydrous substances do not contain water.

words.tr: v. 消灭；歼灭；彻底击败
words.ex: The bomb will annihilate the building.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹会摧毁那栋大楼。
words.en: To annihilate something means to destroy it completely.

words.tr: n. （电解池的）阳极；（原电池的）负极
words.ex: The current flows into the anode during electrolysis.
words.ex_cn: 在电解过程中，电流流入阳极。
words.en: An anode is the positively charged electrode by which the electrons leave a device.

words.tr: n. 异常事物；反常现象；
words.ex: The strange weather this month is an anomaly.
words.ex_cn: 这个月奇怪的天气是一个异常现象。
words.en: Something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected.

words.ex: He has anorexia and eats very little food.
words.ex_cn: 他患有厌食症，吃得很少。
words.en: Anorexia is a psychological disorder characterized by an obsessive desire to lose weight by refusing to eat.

words.ex: Anoxia can be a serious condition that affects brain function.
words.ex_cn: 缺氧症是一种可能严重影响大脑功能的严重病症。
words.en: Anoxia is a condition characterized by an absence of oxygen supply to an organ or a tissue.

words.ex: He takes an antacid when his stomach hurts.
words.ex_cn: 当他胃痛时，他会服用抗酸药。
words.en: A substance that neutralizes stomach acidity and is used to relieve heartburn, indigestion, or an upset stomach.

words.ex: The ant moved its antenna to feel the ground.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁用它的触角感知地面。
words.en: An antenna is a device that sends and receives radio or television signals. In biology, it refers to the long, thin sensory appendages on the heads of insects and crustaceans.

words.tr: n. 国家或组织的法定歌曲
words.ex: The team sang the national anthem before the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛前，球队唱了国歌。
words.en: An anthem is a song that is used to represent a particular nation, society, or group and that is sung on special occasions.

words.ex: He read an anthology of short stories last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了一本短篇故事选集。
words.en: An anthology is a collection of writings, such as poems or stories, that have been chosen by someone because they are considered to be the best or most interesting examples of their kind.

words.ex: The disease anthrax can be fatal if not treated promptly.
words.ex_cn: 炭疽病如果不及时治疗可能会致命。
words.en: Anthrax is a serious infectious disease caused by the bacterium Bacillus anthracis, which can affect both animals and humans.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗菌素治疗感染。
words.en: A substance that can kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms.

words.tr:
adj. 退热的
n. 解热剂
words.ex: The antifebrile medicine reduced his fever.
words.ex_cn: 这种退烧药降低了他体温。
words.en: A substance that reduces fever; antipyretic.

words.ex: The ruins show the antiquity of this civilization.
words.ex_cn: 这些废墟展示了这个文明的古老。
words.en: The ancient past, especially the period before the Middle Ages.

words.ex: The doctor used antiseptic cream on the cut.
words.ex_cn: 医生在伤口上用了防腐药膏。
words.en: An antiseptic is a substance that prevents the growth of disease-causing microorganisms.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an antitoxin to fight the poison.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一种抗毒素来对抗毒素。
words.en: An antitoxin is an antibody with the ability to neutralize a specific toxin.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an antiviral medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一种抗病毒药物。
words.en: A substance that stops a virus from infecting cells or prevents a virus from replicating.

words.ex: This is an antivirus software that protects your computer.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个保护你电脑的抗病毒软件。
words.en: Antivirus software is a program designed to detect and destroy computer viruses.

words.ex: He has appendicitis and needs surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他得了阑尾炎，需要手术。
words.en: Appendicitis is a medical condition in which the appendix becomes inflamed and painful, often requiring surgery to remove the appendix.

words.ex: The appendix contains extra data for the report.
words.ex_cn: 附录包含了报告的额外数据。
words.en: An appendix is a section at the end of a book that contains additional information. It can also refer to the small tube attached to the large intestine in the human body, known as the vermiform appendix.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.tr: n. 海蓝宝石；蓝绿色；海蓝色
words.ex: She wore an aquamarine necklace to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她参加派对时戴了一条海蓝宝项链。
words.en: A transparent blue-green variety of beryl, used as a gemstone.

words.tr: n. 水族馆；水族箱；养鱼缸；
words.ex: We visited the aquarium to see the fish.
words.ex_cn: 我们去水族馆看鱼。
words.en: A tank or building in which fish and other water creatures and plants are kept.

words.tr: adj. 水生的；水栖的；水中的；
words.ex: The fish live in aquatic plants.
words.ex_cn: 这些鱼生活在水生植物中。
words.en: Relating to water; living in or near water or taking place in water.

words.ex: The arbitrator helped the two sides reach an agreement.
words.ex_cn: 仲裁员帮助双方达成了协议。
words.en: An arbitrator is a person who has been officially chosen to make a decision between two people or groups who do not agree.

words.ex: The arboreal squirrel climbs high in the trees.
words.ex_cn: 这种树栖松鼠在高高的树上攀爬。
words.en: Relating to trees; living in trees.

words.tr:
v. 成弧线；
n. 弧；弧形物；
words.ex: The rainbow arcs across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹在天空中形成一道弧线。
words.en: An arc is a smoothly curving line or movement.

words.ex: He loves archaeology and digs old artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱考古学，挖掘古代文物。
words.en: Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.ex: She sang a beautiful aria at the opera.
words.ex_cn: 她在歌剧上唱了一段优美的咏叹调。
words.en: An aria is a song for one voice in an opera, often expressing a character's emotions.

words.tr: n. 贵族政治；贵族统治；贵族
words.ex: The aristocracy lived in big castles long ago.
words.ex_cn: 很久以前，贵族住在巨大的城堡里。
words.en: The highest class in certain societies, especially those holding hereditary titles or offices.

words.ex: He does arithmetic every day with his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和妹妹一起做算术。
words.en: Arithmetic is the part of mathematics that deals with the addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of numbers.

words.ex: The country increased its armament to protect its borders.
words.ex_cn: 该国增加了军备以保护其边境。
words.en: The weapons and military equipment that a country has, or the process of increasing them.

words.ex: The knight wore heavy armor in the battle.
words.ex_cn: 骑士在战斗中穿着沉重的盔甲。
words.en: Armor is a protective covering that is used to prevent damage from being inflicted to an object, individual, or vehicle by direct contact weapons or projectiles, usually during combat.

words.ex: The aroma of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味充满了厨房。
words.en: An aroma is a strong, pleasant smell.

words.tr: n. 心律失常；心律不齐
words.ex: He has arrhythmia and needs to see a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他有心律不齐，需要看医生。
words.en: An arrhythmia is a problem with the rate or rhythm of your heartbeat. It means that your heart beats too quickly, too slowly, or with an irregular pattern.

words.tr: n. 兵工厂；武器库；军械库；
words.ex: The old arsenal now serves as a museum.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧兵工厂现在被用作博物馆。
words.en: An arsenal is a place where weapons and military equipment are stored or made.

words.ex: Arsenic is a poisonous element found in some water.
words.ex_cn: 砷是一种存在于某些水源中的有毒元素。
words.en: A very poisonous metallic element that has three allotropic forms; arsenic and arsenic compounds are used as herbicides and insecticides and various alloys; found in arsenopyrite and orpiment and realgar

words.ex: The artery carries blood from the heart.
words.ex_cn: 动脉将血液从心脏输送到身体。
words.en: An artery is a tube that carries blood from the heart to the rest of the body.

words.ex: He has arthritis in his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他双手有关节炎。
words.en: Arthritis is a medical condition in which the joints in someone's body are swollen and painful.

words.tr:
adj. 特指的；特殊的；挑剔的；
n. 细节；详情；
words.ex: He wants a particular book, not any other.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一本特指的书，不是别的。
words.en: You use particular to emphasize that you are talking about one thing or one kind of thing rather than other similar ones.

words.ex: The artisan makes handmade pottery.
words.ex_cn: 这位工匠制作手工陶器。
words.en: An artisan is someone who makes things by hand, especially using traditional methods.

words.ex: Old houses sometimes have asbestos in the walls.
words.ex_cn: 老房子的墙壁里有时含有石棉。
words.en: A fibrous mineral form of magnesium silicate, used in fire-resistant and insulating materials.

words.tr: adj. 无菌的；经消毒的；冷漠的
words.ex: The nurse used an aseptic technique to clean the wound.
words.ex_cn: 护士使用无菌技术清洁伤口。
words.en: Free from contamination caused by harmful bacteria, viruses, or other microorganisms; surgically clean or sterile.

words.ex: He suffered from asphyxia after breathing in smoke.
words.ex_cn: 他吸入烟雾后因窒息而受苦。
words.en: Asphyxia is a condition arising when the body is deprived of oxygen, causing unconsciousness or death; suffocation.

words.ex: The asteroid flew past Earth safely.
words.ex_cn: 这颗小行星安全地从地球旁飞过。
words.en: An asteroid is a small rocky body orbiting the sun. Large numbers of these, ranging enormously in size, are found between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter, though some have more eccentric orbits.

words.ex: He has asthma and cannot run fast.
words.ex_cn: 他有哮喘，不能跑快。
words.en: A respiratory condition marked by spasms in the bronchi of the lungs, causing difficulty in breathing. It usually results from an allergic reaction or other forms of hypersensitivity.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看星星并学习天文学。
words.en: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.ex: He is an astute businessman who always makes smart decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他是个精明的商人，总是做出明智的决定。
words.en: If you describe someone as astute, you think they are clever and can see through things quickly and make good judgments.

words.tr: n. 收容所；避难所；精神病院；（政治）庇护
words.ex: The old building now serves as an asylum for the homeless.
words.ex_cn: 这栋旧建筑现在是无家可归者的收容所。
words.en: An asylum is a place where people who are in danger or who have no homes can go for safety and protection.

words.ex: The painting has asymmetry in its design.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的构图不对称。
words.en: The quality of being asymmetrical; lack of symmetry.

words.ex: The atom is the smallest part of matter.
words.ex_cn: 原子是物质的最小单位。
words.en: An atom is the smallest unit of ordinary matter that forms a chemical element. Every solid, liquid, gas, and plasma is composed of neutral or ionized atoms.

words.ex: The muscle showed signs of atrophy after the injury.
words.ex_cn: 受伤后，肌肉出现了萎缩的迹象。
words.en: Atrophy refers to the wasting away or decrease in size of an organ or tissue, typically as a result of disease, injury, or lack of use.

words.ex: The doctor gave her atropine to slow her heart rate.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了她阿托品以减缓她的心率。
words.en: Atropine is a toxic alkaloid obtained from the deadly nightshade and related plants, used in medicine to dilate the pupils and to treat certain types of poisoning.

words.ex: The children found old toys in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阁楼上找到了旧玩具。
words.en: An attic is a space or room just below the roof of a building, often used for storage or as an extra room.

words.ex: He wore formal attire to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了正式服装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Clothes, especially fine or formal ones.

words.tr: adj. 非典型的；不规则的
words.ex: He has an atypical way of solving problems.
words.ex_cn: 他解决问题的方式很不寻常。
words.en: Not representative of a type, group, or class; unusual or irregular.

words.ex: The whisper was barely audible.
words.ex_cn: 那耳语几乎听不见。
words.en: If a sound is audible, it is loud enough for you to hear it.

words.ex: The audio signal was clear and loud.
words.ex_cn: 音频信号清晰响亮。
words.en: Audio refers to sound, especially when recorded, transmitted, or reproduced.

words.ex: The audiometer is used to measure hearing sensitivity.
words.ex_cn: 听度计用于测量听觉敏感度。
words.en: An instrument used for measuring hearing acuity for variations in sound intensity and pitch and for tonal purity.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.ex: The farmer uses an auger to drill holes in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 农夫使用螺旋钻在地里钻孔。
words.en: An auger is a tool consisting of a rotating helical shaft used to move material or drill holes.

words.ex: He passed the aural test by listening carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他通过仔细听通过了听力测试。
words.en: Relating to the ear or the sense of hearing.

words.ex: She saw the aurora in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 她在夜空中看到了极光。
words.en: An aurora is a natural light display in the sky, predominantly seen in the high latitude (Arctic and Antarctic) regions, caused by the collision of solar wind and magnetospheric charged particles with the high altitude atmosphere.

words.ex: The doctor auscultated the patient's lungs.
words.ex_cn: 医生听诊了病人的肺部。
words.en: To listen to sounds within the body, especially the heart or lungs, typically using a stethoscope, as part of a medical examination.

words.ex: The clear sky was an auspice of good weather.
words.ex_cn: 晴朗的天空是好天气的预兆。
words.en: An auspice is a sign or omen that is believed to predict the future, often seen as favorable or supportive. It can also refer to the protection or support provided by a person or organization.

words.ex: He lives in Austria.
words.ex_cn: 他住在奥地利。
words.en: Austria is a country in Central Europe, known for its mountainous terrain, classical music, and historical architecture.

words.ex: The authoritarian leader controls everything.
words.ex_cn: 这位专制的领导人控制一切。
words.en: An authoritarian government or leader has complete power and control over the people and does not allow political opposition.

words.ex: He wrote his autobiography when he was 70.
words.ex_cn: 他70岁时写了自传。
words.en: An autobiography is a book about the life of a person, written by that person.

words.tr: n, 高压锅；高压灭菌器
words.ex: The laboratory uses an autoclave to sterilize equipment.
words.ex_cn: 实验室使用高压蒸气灭菌器来消毒设备。
words.en: An autoclave is a device used to sterilize equipment and supplies by subjecting them to high pressure saturated steam at 121 °C or more, typically for around 15–20 minutes depending on the size of the load and the contents.

words.ex: The factory will automate the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 工厂将自动化装配线。
words.en: To automate a factory, office, or industrial process means to put in machines which can do the work instead of people.

words.ex: He works in the automotive industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在汽车工业工作。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with motor vehicles.

words.ex: The doctor did an autopsy to find the cause of death.
words.ex_cn: 医生做了尸检以查明死因。
words.en: An autopsy is a medical examination of a dead body to discover the cause of death.

words.tr:
adj. 辅助的；附属的
n. 辅助物；附属物；助动词
words.ex: He used an auxiliary verb to form the past tense.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了一个助动词来构成过去时。
words.en: An auxiliary is a person or thing that provides additional help or support.

words.ex: Applications arrived in an avalanche after the job posting.
words.ex_cn: 职位发布后，申请纷至沓来。
words.en: An avalanche is a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls quickly down the side of a mountain.

words.tr:
adj. 先锋的；前卫的
n. 先锋派；前卫
words.ex: The artist uses avant-garde styles in her paintings.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家在她的画作中使用前卫的风格。
words.en: Avant-garde is used to describe people or works that are experimental or innovative, particularly in the arts.

words.ex: The avian species flew south for winter.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟类飞往南方过冬。
words.en: Relating to birds.

words.tr: n. 航空；航空学；飞行（术）；
words.ex: He works in aviation as a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名飞行员从事航空工作。
words.en: Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.

words.tr: n. 飞行员；飞机驾驶员
words.ex: The aviator flew a plane over the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员驾机飞越了山脉。
words.en: An aviator is a person who flies an aircraft.

words.ex: The axial wind blew strongly through the valley.
words.ex_cn: 轴向的风猛烈地吹过山谷。
words.en: Relating to or forming an axis; situated around, in the direction of, on, or along an axis.

words.ex: The doctor checked the axilla for swelling.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了腋窝是否有肿胀。
words.en: The axilla is the area under the arm where it joins the body, commonly known as the armpit.

words.ex: The wheel fell off because the axle broke.
words.ex_cn: 车轮掉了，因为车轴断了。
words.en: An axle is a rod or spindle (either fixed or rotating) passing through the center of a wheel or group of wheels.

words.ex: The baboon is climbing a tree.
words.ex_cn: 狒狒正在爬树。
words.en: A baboon is a type of large monkey found in Africa and Arabia, which has a dog-like face and large teeth.

words.tr:
adj. 巴比伦的
n. 巴比伦人；巴比伦语
words.ex: The Babylonian used clay tablets for math.
words.ex_cn: 巴比伦人用泥板做数学。
words.en: Relating to Babylon or its people, culture, or language.

words.ex: He decided to bach after his divorce.
words.ex_cn: 离婚后，他决定过单身生活。
words.en: To live alone or without a partner, especially in a temporary or makeshift accommodation.

words.ex: Bacillus anthracis is the bacterium that causes anthrax.
words.ex_cn: 炭疽杆菌是引起炭疽病的细菌。
words.en: A bacillus is any of a genus (Bacillus) of rod-shaped, gram-positive, aerobic or facultatively anaerobic spore-producing bacteria, some of which cause disease.

words.ex: He is the backbone of the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是团队的中坚。
words.en: The backbone is the most important part of something, providing support and strength.

words.ex: The actors stood in front of the backdrop with a mountain scene.
words.ex_cn: 演员们站在有山景的背景幕布前。
words.en: A backdrop is a large piece of cloth, often with scenery or buildings painted on it, that is hung at the back of a stage in a theatre.

words.tr:
n. 逆光；背景照明
v. 从背后照亮；背景照明；“backlight”的现在分词
words.ex: The photo looked dark because of the backlighting.
words.ex_cn: 由于逆光，这张照片看起来很暗。
words.en: Backlighting is a technique in photography and cinematography where the light source is positioned behind the subject, creating a silhouette effect or highlighting the edges of the subject.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.ex: The disinfectant is bactericidal and can kill a wide range of pathogens.
words.ex_cn: 这种消毒剂具有杀菌作用，可以杀死多种病原体。
words.en: A substance or agent that kills bacteria.

words.ex: He studies bacteriology to learn about harmful bacteria.
words.ex_cn: 他学习细菌学以了解有害细菌。
words.en: The scientific study of bacteria, especially in relation to medicine and agriculture.

words.ex: The bacterium causes sickness in humans.
words.ex_cn: 这种细菌会导致人类生病。
words.en: A bacterium is a very small organism which often causes disease.

words.ex: He wears a badge on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他衬衫上戴着一枚徽章。
words.en: A badge is a small piece of metal, plastic, or cloth which you wear in order to show people that you have a particular rank, job, or belong to a particular group.

words.tr: n. 气球；热气球；玩具气球；球状物；
words.ex: The child held a red balloon at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在派对上拿着一个红色的气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.ex: She applied a soothing balm to the wound.
words.ex_cn: 她在伤口上涂了镇痛软膏。
words.en: A balm is a preparation that soothes, heals, or comforts, often applied to the skin.

words.tr: adj. 波罗的海的；波罗的语的；
words.ex: The Baltic Sea is cold and salty.
words.ex_cn: 波罗的海寒冷且盐分高。
words.en: Relating to the Baltic Sea or the countries bordering it; extremely cold.

words.ex: She tied her bandana around her head to keep the sun out of her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 她把花色丝质大手帕系在头上，以遮挡阳光。
words.en: A bandana is a large, usually colorful kerchief, typically worn on the head or around the neck.

words.ex: The bandit stole money from the bank.
words.ex_cn: 强盗从银行偷了钱。
words.en: A bandit is a person who robs people, especially one of a group of people who attack travelers.

words.ex: The bandleader orchestrated the performance with precision.
words.ex_cn: 乐队领队精准地指挥了这场表演。
words.en: A bandleader is the leader of a band, especially a dance band or jazz band, who typically directs the group's performance and may also play an instrument.

words.ex: The bandmaster leads the school band every morning.
words.ex_cn: 乐队指挥每天早上带领学校乐队。
words.en: A bandmaster is the conductor of a band, especially a military band or brass band, who directs the performance with a baton or by hand gestures.

words.ex: They had a big banquet after the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼后他们举办了一场盛大的宴会。
words.en: A banquet is a large formal meal for many people, often followed by speeches in honor of someone.

words.ex: The fish has a sharp barb on its tail.
words.ex_cn: 这条鱼的尾巴上有一个尖锐的倒刺。
words.en: A barb is a sharp projection near the end of an arrow, fishhook, or similar object, which is angled away from the main point so as to make extraction difficult. It can also refer to a remark that is meant to hurt someone's feelings.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed a barbiturate to help with the patient's insomnia.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一种巴比妥酸盐来帮助病人治疗失眠。
words.en: A barbiturate is a drug that acts as a sedative and is used to treat insomnia, seizures, and to induce anesthesia.

words.ex: The barge carried coal down the river.
words.ex_cn: 驳船沿河运送煤炭。
words.en: A barge is a long, flat-bottomed boat used for carrying freight on canals and rivers.

words.ex: Farmers grow barley for animal feed.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植大麦作为动物饲料。
words.en: Barley is a cereal grain that is used as food and also in making beer and whiskey.

words.ex: The barometer shows that the weather will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 晴雨表显示天气会很好。
words.en: A barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, used especially in forecasting the weather and determining altitude.

words.ex: The baron owns a large castle in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 男爵拥有一座位于乡村的大城堡。
words.en: A baron is a man who is a member of the lowest rank of the nobility, or a powerful businessman with great influence in a particular industry.

words.tr:
n. 巴洛克式；
adj. 巴洛克式的；
words.ex: The church has a baroque style with gold decorations.
words.ex_cn: 这座教堂具有巴洛克风格，装饰有金色元素。
words.en: Baroque is a style of architecture, music, and art that was common in Europe in the 17th and early 18th centuries, characterized by ornate detail.

words.tr: n. 盆地；流域；水池；脸盆；
words.ex: The river flows into a large basin.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入一个巨大的盆地。
words.en: A basin is a large or small depression in the Earth's surface or a large container that holds water.

words.ex: The battalion marched slowly through the town.
words.ex_cn: 那个营缓缓穿过小镇。
words.en: A battalion is a large group of soldiers that consists of three or more companies.

words.ex: We bought spices at the local bazaar.
words.ex_cn: 我们在当地的集市上买了香料。
words.en: A bazaar is a market consisting of rows of shops or stalls, especially in the Middle East, or a sale of miscellaneous contributed articles to benefit some charity.

words.tr: abbr. 卡介苗；“Bacillus Calmette-Guérin”的缩写
words.ex: He received the BCG vaccine as a baby.
words.ex_cn: 他小时候接种了卡介苗。
words.en: Abbreviation for Bacillus Calmette-Guérin, a vaccine used primarily against tuberculosis.

words.ex: She threaded a bead onto the string.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗有孔的小珠穿在绳子上。
words.en: A bead is a small piece of glass, wood, or plastic that is used for decorating clothes or making jewellery.

words.ex: The bird uses its beak to eat seeds.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟用它的喙吃种子。
words.en: The hard, pointed, often curved part of a bird's mouth, used for picking up and eating food.

words.tr:
n. 海狸；海狸毛皮
v. 勤奋工作
words.ex: The beaver builds a dam with sticks and mud.
words.ex_cn: 海狸用树枝和泥土筑坝。
words.en: A beaver is a large rodent with a broad, flat tail, known for building dams and lodges in rivers.

words.tr:
adj. 相宜的
v. 适宜；合适；“befit”的现在分词
words.ex: Her attire was befitting for the formal occasion.
words.ex_cn: 她的着装适合正式场合。
words.en: If something is befitting, it is appropriate or suitable for a particular person, thing, or occasion.

words.tr:
n. 风箱（复数名词）
v. 怒吼；吼叫；咆哮；“bellow”的第三人称单数
n. 咆哮；怒号；“bellow”的复数
words.ex: The blacksmith pulled the bellows to make the fire hotter.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠拉风箱让火更旺。
words.en: A bellows is a device for producing a strong current of air, used especially for blowing a fire.

words.ex: He rubbed his belly after eating too much.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完太多后揉了揉腹部。
words.en: The belly is the front part of a person's or animal's body between the chest and the legs.

words.tr:
n. 腹痛
v. 发牢骚
words.ex: He has a bellyache from eating too much candy.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多糖果而肚子疼。
words.en: To bellyache means to complain in a whining or grumbling manner.

words.ex: She pointed to her belly-button as a sign of her vulnerability.
words.ex_cn: 她指着自己的肚脐，表示她的脆弱。
words.en: The small, round, and often slightly protruding scar on the abdomen that marks the former attachment of the umbilical cord.

words.tr:
adj. 强制性节约的；节省开支的
n. 紧缩开支
words.ex: The company had to implement belt-tightening measures to survive the economic downturn.
words.ex_cn: 公司不得不实施强制性节约措施以应对经济衰退。
words.en: Belt-tightening refers to the act of reducing expenditures or being more economical, especially in response to financial difficulties.

words.ex: The benign teacher always helped students after class.
words.ex_cn: 这位仁慈的老师总是在课后帮助学生。
words.en: A benign substance or process does not have any harmful effects.

words.ex: He left his books as a bequest to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的书作为遗赠给了图书馆。
words.en: A bequest is money or property which you legally leave to someone when you die.

words.ex: Beriberi is a disease caused by a deficiency of vitamin B1.
words.ex_cn: 脚气病是由于维生素B1缺乏引起的疾病。
words.en: A disease caused by a deficiency of thiamine (vitamin B1), affecting many systems of the body, including the nerves, heart, and muscles.

words.tr:
n. 泊位；（船上的）卧铺
v. 停泊；占铺位
words.ex: The ship found a berth at the dock.
words.ex_cn: 船在码头找到了停泊位。
words.en: A berth is a bed on a boat, train, or other vehicle, or a place where a boat or ship can be tied up in a harbor.

words.ex: He was beset by problems at work.
words.ex_cn: 他被工作中的问题困扰。
words.en: If someone or something is beset by problems or fears, they have many problems or fears which affect them severely.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr: adj. 两院制的；有参众两院的
words.ex: The country has a bicameral parliament.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家有一个两院制议会。
words.en: A bicameral legislature is one that is divided into two separate assemblies, chambers, or houses.

words.ex: Bicarbonate of soda is commonly used in baking.
words.ex_cn: 小苏打常用于烘焙。
words.en: A bicarbonate is a salt containing the anion HCO3−, which is the conjugate base of carbonic acid.

words.ex: The two countries signed a bilateral agreement.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项双边协议。
words.en: Involving or affecting two parties, countries, etc.

words.ex: He feels sick because of too much bile.
words.ex_cn: 他因为胆汁过多而感到恶心。
words.en: Bile is a bitter, yellow-green fluid that is produced by the liver and helps in the digestion of fats.

words.tr:
adj. 双眼的；两眼用的
n. （通常用复数）双筒望远镜
words.ex: He uses binocular to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用双筒望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: An optical instrument, such as a pair of field glasses or opera glasses, designed for simultaneous use by both eyes and consisting of two small telescopes joined together.

words.ex: This substance is known for its bioactive properties.
words.ex_cn: 这种物质以其生物活性特性而闻名。
words.en: Having an effect on a living organism.

words.ex: He is learning biochemistry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习生物化学。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with the chemical processes occurring within living organisms.

words.ex: The biographer wrote about the artist's life.
words.ex_cn: 传记作家写了这位艺术家的一生。
words.en: A biographer is a person who writes an account of someone's life.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.ex: The biologist studies animals in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位生物学家在森林里研究动物。
words.en: A biologist is a scientist who studies living organisms and their relationship to their environment.

words.tr: n. 活组织检查；切片检查
words.ex: The doctor recommended a biopsy to determine the nature of the lump.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议进行活组织检查以确定肿块的性质。
words.en: A biopsy is a medical test involving the removal of cells or tissues for examination to determine the presence or extent of a disease.

words.ex: Biostatistics is a critical tool in medical research.
words.ex_cn: 生物统计学是医学研究中的一个关键工具。
words.en: Biostatistics is the application of statistics to a wide range of topics in biology. It encompasses the design of biological experiments, especially in medicine, pharmacy, agriculture and fishery; the collection, summarization, and analysis of data from those experiments; and the interpretation of, and inference from, the results.

words.ex: The bishop moves diagonally across the chessboard.
words.ex_cn: 象在国际象棋棋盘上斜着走。
words.en: A bishop is a senior member of the Christian clergy, usually in charge of a diocese and empowered to confer holy orders.

words.ex: The bison walks slowly across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 野牛慢慢地走过草原。
words.en: A bison is a large, wild animal that is related to the cow and is native to North America and Europe. Bison have a large head, a humped back, and are covered with thick, shaggy hair.

words.tr: adj. 离奇的；奇特的；奇怪的；
words.ex: The clown wore a bizarre hat with three eyes.
words.ex_cn: 小丑戴着一顶有三只眼睛的离奇帽子。
words.en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

words.ex: The city had a blackout during the war.
words.ex_cn: 战争期间，这座城市实行了灯火管制。
words.en: A blackout is a period of time during which there is no electricity, or when the lights are turned off, especially as a result of an emergency or for a theatrical effect. It can also refer to a temporary loss of memory or consciousness.

words.ex: The blacksmith makes horseshoes with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠用锤子打马蹄铁。
words.en: A blacksmith is a person who makes and repairs things in iron by hand.

words.ex: He feels pain in his bladder.
words.ex_cn: 他感到膀胱疼痛。
words.en: A bladder is a part of your body that is shaped like a bag and holds urine until it is passed out of the body.

words.tr: v. 使变白；（脸色）变苍白；焯
words.ex: She blanches the vegetables before freezing them.
words.ex_cn: 她在冷冻蔬菜之前先焯水。
words.en: To blanch means to make something white or pale, often by removing color or by causing it to lose color. It can also refer to the process of briefly boiling vegetables and then plunging them into cold water to halt the cooking process.

words.ex: The soup was too bland for me.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太淡了，我不喜欢。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as bland, you mean that they are rather dull and unexciting.

words.ex: She added bleach to the white shirt to make it brighter.
words.ex_cn: 她往白衬衫里加了漂白剂，让它更亮。
words.en: To bleach something means to make it white or pale by using a chemical or by exposing it to sunlight.

words.tr: adj. 无望的；凄凉的；荒凉的；
words.ex: The future looks bleak without a job.
words.ex_cn: 没有工作，未来看起来毫无希望。
words.en: If you describe a situation as bleak, you mean that it seems unlikely to improve or get better.

words.tr: adj. 视力模糊的；蒙眬的；惺忪的
words.ex: He woke up with bleary eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他醒来时眼睛模糊。
words.en: If your eyes are bleary, they look dull or unfocused, usually because you are tired or have been crying.

words.tr: n. 幸事； v. “bless”的现在分词；
words.ex: Finding a good job after graduation was a blessing.
words.ex_cn: 毕业后找到一份好工作是一件幸事。
words.en: A blessing is a prayer asking for God's favor and protection, or a beneficial thing for which one is grateful.

words.tr: n. （雷达等的）光点或信号；暂时的突变
words.ex: The radar screen showed a blip moving across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 雷达屏幕显示出一个光点在空中移动。
words.en: A blip is a small spot of light on a radar screen, or a minor and typically temporary deviation from a general trend.

words.ex: He got a blister on his foot from new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他新鞋磨出了一个水泡。
words.en: A blister is a small pocket of fluid within the upper layers of the skin, typically caused by forceful rubbing, burning, freezing, chemical exposure or infection. As a verb, it means to form such a pocket of fluid.

words.ex: A blizzard covered the town in snow.
words.ex_cn: 一场暴风雪将整个小镇覆盖在雪中。
words.en: A blizzard is a severe snowstorm with strong winds.

words.ex: The software bloat makes the phone slow.
words.ex_cn: 软件臃肿让手机变慢。
words.en: To bloat means to cause something to swell up or become excessively large, often in an unhealthy or undesirable way.

words.ex: The roses are in bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰在春天开花。
words.en: When a plant or tree blooms, it produces flowers. The period during which a plant or tree produces flowers is also known as its bloom.

words.tr:
n. （果树的）花朵；
v. 开花；
words.ex: The apple tree is full of blossom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，苹果树上开满了花。
words.en: When a tree or plant blossoms, it produces flowers before producing fruit that can be eaten.

words.ex: The company won a blue-ribbon award for its innovative products.
words.ex_cn: 该公司因其创新产品而获得了一等奖。
words.en: Of the highest quality or distinction; first-rate.

words.tr: n. 公寓；寄宿公寓；供膳寄宿舍
words.ex: She lives in a boardinghouse near the school.
words.ex_cn: 她住在学校附近的一栋公寓里。
words.en: A boardinghouse is a house where people pay to stay and receive meals.

words.ex: The children walked carefully through the bog.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们小心地走过沼泽。
words.en: A bog is an area of wet muddy ground that is too soft to support a heavy body.

words.ex: Exercise can bolster your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的健康。
words.en: If you bolster something such as someone's confidence or courage, you increase it. A bolster is also a long, firm pillow.

words.ex: The soldiers were bombarded with cannon fire.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们遭到炮火轰击。
words.en: To bombard someone or something means to attack them continuously with bombs, shells, or other missiles. It can also mean to subject someone to a lot of something, such as questions or information.

words.ex: The gold mine became a bonanza for the town.
words.ex_cn: 这个金矿成了这个小镇的致富之源。
words.en: A bonanza is a situation or event that creates a sudden increase in wealth, good fortune, or profits.

words.tr: adj. 如骨的；多骨的；瘦骨嶙峋的
words.ex: He has a bony hand that looks thin and weak.
words.ex_cn: 他有一只骨瘦如柴的手，看起来又细又弱。
words.en: If you describe someone as bony, you mean that they are very thin so that their bones stick out.

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.tr:
n. 飞去来器；回旋镖；回力镖
v. 自食其果；害人反害己
words.ex: He threw the boomerang and it came back to him.
words.ex_cn: 他扔出了回旋镖，它又飞回到他身边。
words.en: A boomerang is a curved piece of wood which comes back to you if you throw it correctly. It is used by Australian Aborigines for hunting and for sport.

words.ex: Clean water is a boon to the village.
words.ex_cn: 干净的水对这个村庄是有益的。
words.en: A boon is something that is very helpful and improves the quality of life.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.ex: The boreal forest is cold and full of pine trees.
words.ex_cn: 北方森林寒冷且长满松树。
words.en: Of or relating to the north or the north wind.

words.tr:
n. 胸；怀；（女性的）乳房
adj. 亲密的；知心的
words.ex: She held the baby close to her bosom.
words.ex_cn: 她把婴儿紧紧抱在胸前。
words.en: Your bosom is the front part of your chest, especially the part that is covered by your clothes and where your breasts are.

words.ex: He loves studying botany in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在花园里学习植物学。
words.en: Botany is the scientific study of plants.

words.ex: He climbed a big boulder near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他爬上了河边的一块大岩石。
words.en: A boulder is a large rounded rock.

words.tr: n. 门卫；保镖；庞然大物
words.ex: He worked as a bouncer at the nightclub.
words.ex_cn: 他在夜总会当保镖。
words.en: A bouncer is a person employed by a nightclub or similar establishment to prevent troublemakers from entering or to eject them from the premises.

words.ex: She bought a bouquet of flowers for her mom.
words.ex_cn: 她为妈妈买了一束花。
words.en: A bouquet is a bunch of flowers that is attractively arranged, especially one that is given to someone as a present.

words.tr:
n. 中产阶级的人；资产阶级的人
adj. 中产阶级的；追求名利的；资产阶级的
words.ex: He lives a bourgeois life with a big house and a car.
words.ex_cn: 他过着资产阶级的生活，有一栋大房子和一辆车。
words.en: If you describe people, their way of life, or their attitudes as bourgeois, you are criticizing them for caring too much about money and possessions and for being too conventional.

words.tr: n. 一回；一次；发作；拳击比赛
words.ex: He had a bout of coughing last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳了一阵子。
words.en: A bout of something is a short period of time during which it occurs a lot or is especially severe.

words.ex: She bought a dress from a small boutique downtown.
words.ex_cn: 她在市中心的一家小型时装精品屋买了一条裙子。
words.en: A boutique is a small shop that sells stylish clothes, shoes, or jewelry.

words.ex: The doctor checked his bowel for signs of infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的肠是否有感染迹象。
words.en: The lower part of the alimentary canal from the end of the stomach to the anus.

words.tr:
n. 支撑物；支架；牙箍
v. 支撑；绷紧；紧靠；准备好
words.ex: The old bookshelf needs a brace to stay steady.
words.ex_cn: 旧书架需要一个支撑物来保持稳定。
words.en: To brace oneself means to prepare oneself for something difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr:
n. 辫子；穗带
v. 编辫子；编织
words.ex: She wore a long braid down her back.
words.ex_cn: 她身后垂着一条长长的辫子。
words.en: A braid is a complex structure or pattern formed by intertwining three or more strands of flexible material such as textile fibers, wire, or hair.

words.ex: Nike is a famous brand.
words.ex_cn: 耐克是一个著名品牌。
words.en: A brand is a name, term, design, symbol, or any other feature that identifies one seller's good or service as distinct from those of other sellers.

words.ex: The view from the mountain is breathtaking.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊叹。
words.en: If you say that something is breathtaking, you mean that it is extremely beautiful or amazing.

words.tr:
v. 酿造；沏；酝酿
n. 酿造的饮料；啤酒
words.ex: He brews coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冲咖啡。
words.en: If you brew tea or coffee, you make it by pouring hot water over tea leaves or ground coffee. If you brew beer, you make it by soaking grain in water and then fermenting it.

words.tr:
n. 边；边缘；帽边
v. （装）满；（使）溢出
words.ex: The cup is full to the brim.
words.ex_cn: 杯子装得满满的。
words.en: The top edge of a container or the projecting edge of a hat.

words.tr:
adj. 毛发竖立的；浓密粗硬的；精神焕发的
v. 大为恼怒；耸起毛发；“bristle”的现在分词
words.ex: The cat was bristling with anger.
words.ex_cn: 那只猫因愤怒而毛发竖立。
words.en: If something is bristling with particular things, it has a lot of them or they are very noticeable.

words.ex: They watched a musical on Broadway last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚在百老汇看了一部音乐剧。
words.en: Broadway is a major thoroughfare in New York City, best known for its theaters and entertainment venues, particularly those presenting musicals.

words.tr: n. 经纪业务；经纪人佣金（或回扣）
words.ex: He works at a brokerage firm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家经纪公司工作。
words.en: A brokerage is a company that buys and sells shares, bonds, and other investments for people and organizations.

words.ex: He has a bronchial infection.
words.ex_cn: 他患有支气管感染。
words.en: Relating to the bronchi or bronchial tubes.

words.ex: The bronchiole is a small airway in the lungs.
words.ex_cn: 细支气管是肺部的小气道。
words.en: A bronchiole is any of the minute branches into which a bronchus divides.

words.ex: He has bronchitis and can't stop coughing.
words.ex_cn: 他得了支气管炎，一直止不住咳嗽。
words.en: Bronchitis is an illness in which the bronchial tubes become inflamed and produce a lot of mucus, causing coughing and difficulty in breathing.

words.ex: The bronchus carries air to the lungs.
words.ex_cn: 支气管将空气输送到肺部。
words.en: A bronchus is a passage of airway in the respiratory system that conducts air into the lungs.

words.tr:
n. 小河；溪
v. （不）忍受；（不）容忍
words.ex: The child jumps over the brook.
words.ex_cn: 孩子跳过小溪。
words.en: A small stream; to tolerate or allow something.

words.tr: n. 肉汤；（鱼、肉或蔬菜）汤
words.ex: He is drinking hot broth for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他正在喝热汤当晚餐。
words.en: A liquid in which meat, fish, cereal grains, or vegetables have been cooked; it forms the basis of many soups and sauces.

words.tr: v. 擦伤；挫伤；出现伤痕；
words.ex: He bruised his knee when he fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来时擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: A bruise is a mark that appears on your skin after you have been injured, but the skin is not broken.

words.ex: He answered the question brusquely.
words.ex_cn: 他唐突地回答了这个问题。
words.en: In a blunt or direct manner, often considered rude or abrupt.

words.ex: The buccal cavity is the space between the cheeks and the teeth.
words.ex_cn: 口腔是面颊和牙齿之间的空间。
words.en: Relating to the cheek or the mouth.

words.tr:
n. 带扣；皮带扣
v. （使）搭扣扣住
words.ex: The belt has a shiny buckle.
words.ex_cn: 这条皮带有一个闪亮的带扣。
words.en: A buckle is a piece of metal or plastic attached to one end of a belt or strap, which is used to fasten it. As a verb, to buckle means to fasten something with a buckle or to bend or collapse under pressure.

words.ex: He practices Buddhism every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上修行佛教。
words.en: Buddhism is a religion and philosophy based on the teachings of the Buddha, emphasizing the elimination of suffering and the attainment of enlightenment.

words.ex: The buffalo walks slowly across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 水牛缓慢地走过草原。
words.en: A buffalo is a large animal of the cattle family, with long, curved horns. In North America, the buffalo is also called the bison.

words.ex: The computer uses a buffer to store data temporarily.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用缓冲区临时存储数据。
words.en: A buffer is something that prevents something else from being harmed or that reduces the impact of something.

words.ex: He plays the bugle at morning parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在晨练时吹小号。
words.en: A bugle is a simple brass instrument consisting of a metal tube with a narrow opening at one end and a flared opening at the other end, played by blowing into it.

words.ex: The bulb broke when it fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡掉到地上时碎了。
words.en: A bulb is the glass part of an electric lamp, which gives out light when electricity passes through it. It can also refer to a rounded underground storage organ present in some plants, notably those of the lily family, consisting of a short stem surrounded by fleshy scale leaves or leaf bases, lying dormant over winter.

words.tr:
n. 膨胀；凸出部分；暴涨
v. 膨胀；凸出；急增
words.ex: The balloon begins to bulge when filled with air.
words.ex_cn: 气球充气时开始鼓起来。
words.en: If something bulges, it sticks out or swells in a rounded shape.

words.tr:
n. 浮标；浮筒
v. 使浮起；支撑；鼓励
words.ex: The buoy floats on the water.
words.ex_cn: 浮标漂浮在水面上。
words.en: A buoy is a floating object that is anchored in water to mark a location, warn of danger, or indicate a navigational channel.

words.tr: adj. 繁重的；累赘的；难于负担的
words.ex: The homework was burdensome and took all night.
words.ex_cn: 作业负担沉重，花了一整晚时间。
words.en: If you describe something as burdensome, you mean it is very difficult to cope with or manage because it is so heavy, large, or complex.

words.ex: The weather bureau issued a storm warning.
words.ex_cn: 气象局发布了风暴预警。
words.en: A bureau is an office, organization, or government department that collects and distributes information.

words.tr: n. 官僚主义；官僚机构
words.ex: He hates the bureaucracy in government offices.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌政府办公室里的官僚主义。
words.en: Bureaucracy refers to a system of government or business that has many complicated rules and ways of doing things.

words.ex: The bureaucrat signed the paper slowly.
words.ex_cn: 这位官僚慢慢地签了那张纸。
words.en: A bureaucrat is an official who works in a bureaucracy, especially one who follows rules and procedures rigidly.

words.tr: n. 炉子；煤气头；燃烧器
words.ex: He turned on the burner to boil water.
words.ex_cn: 他打开炉子来烧水。
words.en: A burner is a device on a stove, cooker, or heater that produces a flame or heat for cooking or heating.

words.tr:
v. 挖洞；钻进；翻寻
n. 地洞
words.ex: The rabbit burrows under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 兔子在树下打洞。
words.en: A burrow is a hole or tunnel dug by a small animal, such as a rabbit or a mole, as a dwelling. As a verb, to burrow means to dig a hole or tunnel for habitation or refuge.

words.tr: n. 蒲式耳（谷物计量单位）
words.ex: He bought a bushel of apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一蒲式耳的苹果。
words.en: A unit of measure for grains, fruit, etc., equivalent to eight gallons in the US and to approximately 36.4 liters in the UK.

words.ex: He hurt his buttock when he fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒在地板上时伤到了臀部。
words.en: One of the two rounded parts of the body that form the bottom.

words.tr:
n. 扶墙；拱壁
v. 支持
words.ex: The old wall needs a buttress to stay standing.
words.ex_cn: 这面旧墙需要一个支撑物来保持不倒。
words.en: A buttress is a structure built against or projecting from a wall which serves to support or reinforce the wall. As a verb, to buttress means to support or strengthen something.

words.ex: The factory makes cheese, and whey is a by-product.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂生产奶酪，乳清是副产品。
words.en: A by-product is something that is produced as a result of making something else, or something unexpected that happens as a result of something.

words.ex: The cactus grows in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 仙人掌生长在沙漠中。
words.en: A cactus is a plant that grows in extremely dry, hot areas and has thick stems for storing water and usually has spines.

words.tr: n. 韵律；节奏；抑扬顿挫
words.ex: The dancer moved with a steady cadence.
words.ex_cn: 舞者以稳定的节奏舞动。
words.en: The rhythm or sequence of sounds or movements in speech, music, dance, etc.

words.tr: n. 干部；骨干分子；骨骼；核心；中心
words.ex: The cadre of the company is well-trained.
words.ex_cn: 公司的骨干队伍训练有素。
words.en: A cadre is a small group of people who are specially chosen and trained for a particular purpose or job.

words.ex: The earthquake was a terrible calamity.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场巨大的灾难。
words.en: A calamity is an event that causes great harm or damage, such as a flood or a fire.

words.ex: Milk has a lot of calcium.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶含有大量的钙。
words.en: A chemical element that is present in teeth and bones and is necessary for their health.

words.tr: n. 微积分学；（人体内的）结石
words.ex: He is learning calculus at school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学校学习微积分。
words.en: Calculus is a branch of mathematics that deals with the finding and properties of derivatives and integrals of functions, by methods originally based on the summation of infinitesimal differences.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the calf every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂小牛。
words.en: A calf is a young cow or bull. It can also refer to the fleshy part of the back of the human leg below the knee.

words.tr: n. 校准；测定刻度；标度
words.ex: The technician did the calibration before the test.
words.ex_cn: 技术人员在测试前进行了校准。
words.en: Calibration refers to the process of checking or adjusting the accuracy of a measuring instrument or experimental procedure by comparison with a standard.

words.tr: adj. 铁石心肠的；无情的；起老茧的
words.ex: He was callous to his friend's pain.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的痛苦无动于衷。
words.en: A callous person or action is very cruel and shows no concern for other people or their feelings.

words.tr: n. 硬皮；老茧；胼胝；愈伤组织
words.ex: His hands have a thick callus from working every day.
words.ex_cn: 他的手因为每天工作长了厚厚的茧。
words.en: A callus is an area of thick, hard skin that forms on the body, especially on the hands or feet, as a result of repeated friction or pressure.

words.ex: She planted a camellia in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种了一株山茶花。
words.en: A camellia is a type of evergreen shrub or small tree with glossy leaves and waxy, rose-like flowers.

words.tr: n. 小配角；小品文；浮雕宝石
words.ex: She appeared in a cameo role in the film.
words.ex_cn: 她在电影中扮演了一个配角。
words.en: A cameo is a small but noticeable part in a film or play, often played by a famous actor or actress. It can also refer to a piece of jewelry consisting of a raised design on a background of a different color.

words.ex: Camphor is used in some medicinal products.
words.ex_cn: 樟脑用于某些药品中。
words.en: A white, crystalline substance with a strong odor and bitter taste, obtained from the wood and bark of the camphor tree and used in medicine, mothballs, and plastics.

words.ex: The bone was found to be highly cancellous, indicating a high level of porosity.
words.ex_cn: 发现骨头高度多孔，表明孔隙度很高。
words.en: Cancellous bone, also known as spongy bone, is a type of bone tissue that is highly porous and found at the ends of long bones. It has a higher surface area to volume ratio than cortical bone, making it lighter and less dense.

words.ex: He spoke with candor about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他坦率地谈到了自己的错误。
words.en: the quality of being open and honest in expression; frankness.

words.ex: The old man walks with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人拄着藤杖走路。
words.en: A cane is a long, thin stick that you can use to help you walk, or it is a stick used for punishing people by hitting them. It is also a tall, hard plant like bamboo, from which sugar is made.

words.tr:
adj. 犬的；狗的；似犬的；犬科的
n. 犬；犬齿
words.ex: The dog has sharp canine teeth.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗有锋利的犬齿。
words.en: Canine refers to anything related to dogs or the family Canidae, which includes dogs, wolves, foxes, and other similar animals.

words.ex: The sore on his lip turned into a canker.
words.ex_cn: 他嘴唇上的疮变成了溃疡。
words.en: A canker is something evil that spreads and affects things or people, or a disease that affects plants.

words.ex: Some ancient tribes practiced cannibalism in rituals.
words.ex_cn: 一些古代部落在仪式中实行同类相食。
words.en: Cannibalism is the practice of eating the flesh of one's own species.

words.ex: The nurse inserted a cannula into his arm.
words.ex_cn: 护士将一根导管插入他的手臂。
words.en: A cannula is a thin tube that can be inserted into the body, often to remove or deliver fluid.

words.ex: The tent has a waterproof canopy.
words.ex_cn: 这顶帐篷有一个防水天篷。
words.en: A canopy is a layer of something that spreads out and covers an area, especially the branches and leaves that spread out at the top of trees in a forest.

words.tr: n. 康塔塔；清唱剧；大合唱
words.ex: The choir sang a beautiful cantata last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 上个星期日，合唱团演唱了一首优美的清唱剧。
words.en: A cantata is a musical composition for voices and orchestra, typically in several movements, often involving a choir.

words.ex: The capacitor has a high capacitance.
words.ex_cn: 这个电容器的电容很高。
words.en: Capacitance is the ability of a system to store an electric charge.

words.ex: The capacitor stores electric charge.
words.ex_cn: 电容器储存电荷。
words.en: A capacitor is a device that stores electrical energy in an electric field.

words.tr:
n. 毛细血管
adj. 毛细管的；毛细作用的
words.ex: Blood moves through tiny capillary tubes.
words.ex_cn: 血液通过微小的毛细管流动。
words.en: A capillary is a very small blood vessel in the body that connects arteries and veins and allows the exchange of oxygen and nutrients between blood and tissues.

words.ex: He took a capsule for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒胶囊来缓解头痛。
words.en: A capsule is a small container or case, especially one that is sealed and contains a dose of medicine, or a spacecraft's compartment for astronauts.

words.tr:
n. 插图说明；标题；字幕
v. 加上说明；加上标题；加上字幕
words.ex: The photo has a caption that says 'Happy birthday'.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片有一个标题，写着‘生日快乐’。
words.en: A caption is a short piece of text under a picture in a book, magazine, or newspaper that describes the picture or explains what is happening in it.

words.ex: The turtle's carapace provided excellent protection.
words.ex_cn: 乌龟的甲壳提供了极好的保护。
words.en: A carapace is the hard protective shell of some animals, such as turtles and crabs.

words.ex: The soldier carries a carbine in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在森林里携带一支卡宾枪。
words.en: A carbine is a short-barreled rifle, often used by cavalry and mounted infantry.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.ex: Limestone contains calcium carbonate.
words.ex_cn: 石灰石含有碳酸钙。
words.en: A carbonate is a salt of carbonic acid, containing the anion CO₃²⁻, or the compound CO₂ combined with a metal.

words.ex: Smoking exposes you to many carcinogens.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会让你接触到许多致癌物。
words.en: A carcinogen is any substance, radionuclide, or radiation that is an agent directly involved in causing cancer.

words.ex: The study focused on the carcinogenesis process in humans.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究专注于人类致癌过程。
words.en: Carcinogenesis is the process by which normal cells are transformed into cancer cells, involving a series of genetic mutations and cellular changes.

words.ex: The cardiac patient needs to rest daily.
words.ex_cn: 这位心脏病人需要每天休息。
words.en: Cardiac means relating to the heart.

words.ex: The doctor analyzed the cardiogram to assess the patient's heart condition.
words.ex_cn: 医生分析心电图以评估患者的心脏状况。
words.en: A cardiogram is a graphical record of the heart's electrical activity, used in diagnosing heart conditions.

words.ex: He specialized in cardiology after completing his medical degree.
words.ex_cn: 他在完成医学学位后专攻心脏病学。
words.en: Cardiology is the branch of medicine that deals with diseases and abnormalities of the heart.

words.ex: He runs every day to keep his cardiovascular system healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步以保持心血管系统健康。
words.en: Relating to the heart and the blood vessels.

words.ex: His careerism made him ignore his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心让他忽视了朋友。
words.en: Careerism refers to the tendency to prioritize one's career advancement over other aspects of life, often at the expense of personal relationships or ethical considerations.

words.ex: The caribou migrate across the tundra every year.
words.ex_cn: 北美驯鹿每年都会穿越苔原迁徙。
words.en: A caribou is a large North American deer with large flat antlers, also known as a reindeer in Europe.

words.ex: The old man had caries in his jawbone.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人的颌骨患有骨疡。
words.en: Caries is the decay of bones or teeth, especially dental cavities caused by bacteria.

words.ex: Lions are carnivores that eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是吃肉的食肉动物。
words.en: A carnivore is an animal that eats the flesh of other animals.

words.ex: He caught a big carp in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条大鲤鱼。
words.en: To complain or find fault continually, typically about trivial matters.

words.ex: The cartilage in his knee hurts when he runs.
words.ex_cn: 他的膝盖软骨在跑步时会疼。
words.en: Cartilage is a strong, flexible connective tissue found in various parts of the body, including the joints, the rib cage, the ear, the nose, the bronchial tubes, and the intervertebral discs. It is not as hard and rigid as bone, but it is stiffer and less flexible than muscle.

words.tr: n. 弹药筒；笔芯；墨盒；胶卷筒；录音带盒
words.ex: He loaded a new cartridge into the gun.
words.ex_cn: 他往枪里装了一枚新弹药筒。
words.en: A cartridge is a container holding a spool of photographic film, a quantity of ink, or other item or substance, designed for insertion into a mechanism.

words.ex: A cascade of complaints flooded the office.
words.ex_cn: 大量投诉涌进了办公室。
words.en: A cascade is a small waterfall or a series of small waterfalls. As a verb, it means to flow or fall in or like a cascade.

words.ex: He drank tea made from cascara.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了用卡斯卡拉制成的茶。
words.en: Cascara is the dried bark of a tree, used as a laxative.

words.ex: He took a spoon of castor oil for his stomach ache.
words.ex_cn: 他为了缓解胃痛喝了一勺蓖麻油。
words.en: a type of oil obtained from the seeds of a plant, used in medicine and industry; a small animal with soft fur, a flat tail, and strong teeth, which lives near water and builds dams

words.ex: Catabolism is the set of metabolic pathways that break down molecules into smaller units.
words.ex_cn: 分解代谢是一系列将分子分解成更小单位的代谢途径。
words.en: The metabolic breakdown of complex molecules into simpler ones, often resulting in the release of energy.

words.ex: The enzyme acts as a catalyst in the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶在反应中充当催化剂。
words.en: A catalyst is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change. In a broader sense, it can also refer to a person or thing that precipitates a change.

words.ex: The old man has a cataract in his right eye.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人右眼有白内障。
words.en: A cataract is a medical condition in which the lens of the eye becomes progressively opaque, resulting in blurred vision. It can also refer to a large waterfall.

words.ex: The caterpillar is eating leaves on the tree.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫正在树上吃叶子。
words.en: A caterpillar is a small, worm-like animal that eventually develops into a butterfly or moth.

words.ex: The doctor put a catheter into his bladder.
words.ex_cn: 医生把导管插入了他的膀胱。
words.en: A catheter is a thin tube made from medical grade materials serving a broad range of functions. Catheters are medical devices that can be inserted in the body to treat diseases or perform a surgical procedure.

words.tr: n. （电解池的）阴极；（原电池的）正极
words.ex: In a battery, the cathode is the positive terminal.
words.ex_cn: 在电池中，阴极是正极。
words.en: The cathode is the electrode from which a conventional current leaves a polarized electrical device.

words.tr:
adj. 腐蚀性的；苛性的；尖酸刻薄的
n. 腐蚀剂
words.ex: The caustic liquid burned through the metal.
words.ex_cn: 这种腐蚀性的液体腐蚀了金属。
words.en: A caustic substance is able to burn or destroy organic tissue by chemical action. Caustic remarks are extremely critical, sarcastic, or bitter.

words.ex: He eats celery every day for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他每天午餐都吃芹菜。
words.en: Celery is a vegetable with long pale green stalks. It is eaten raw in salads or cooked as a vegetable.

words.tr: adj. 天空的；天体的；天国的；
words.ex: The celestial lights shone brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中的光芒在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: Relating to the sky or the heavens; belonging or relating to heaven as the abode of the gods.

words.ex: He cannot eat bread because he is celiac.
words.ex_cn: 他不能吃面包，因为他有乳糜泻。
words.en: Celiac refers to something related to the abdomen or the celiac disease, an autoimmune disorder where the ingestion of gluten leads to damage in the small intestine.

words.ex: He plays the cello every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉大提琴。
words.en: A cello is a large stringed instrument of the violin family, tuned an octave below the viola.

words.ex: The cellular structure of plants is very small.
words.ex_cn: 植物的细胞结构非常微小。
words.en: Relating to or consisting of cells; having a porous structure.

words.tr: n. 植物纤维质；纤维素；
words.ex: Trees contain a lot of cellulose in their walls.
words.ex_cn: 树木的细胞壁中含有大量的植物纤维质。
words.en: Cellulose is a substance that exists in the cell walls of plants and is used to make paper, textiles, and explosives.

words.tr:
adj. 一百年的
n. 百年纪念
words.ex: The city held a centennial parade to celebrate 100 years.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市举行了一场百年游行来庆祝一百周年。
words.en: A centennial is the one-hundredth anniversary of an event, or something that happens every hundred years.

words.tr:
n. 离心机；离心分离机；离心过滤机
v. 对…使用离心机
words.ex: The scientist uses a centrifuge to separate liquids.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用离心机分离液体。
words.en: A centrifuge is a machine that spins a container very quickly so that the heavier liquids and any solids are forced to the outer edge or the bottom.

words.ex: The baby is in a cephalic position before birth.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在出生前是头位。
words.en: Relating to the head or the head end of the body.

words.tr:
n. 陶瓷制品；陶瓷器；
adj. 陶质的；制陶的；
words.ex: He bought a ceramic bowl at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个陶瓷碗。
words.en: Ceramic is a hard material that is made by baking clay or similar substances at high temperatures. It is used to make things such as tiles, dishes, and statues.

words.ex: The cerebellum is crucial for coordinating movement.
words.ex_cn: 小脑对于协调运动至关重要。
words.en: The cerebellum is a major feature of the hindbrain of all vertebrates. Although usually smaller than the cerebrum, in some animals such as the mormyrid fishes it may be as large as or even larger. In humans, the cerebellum plays an important role in motor control. It may also be involved in some cognitive functions such as attention and language, and in regulating fear and pleasure responses, but its movement-related functions are the most solidly established.

words.ex: The cerebral cortex controls thinking and memory.
words.ex_cn: 大脑皮层控制思考和记忆。
words.en: Relating to the brain or the intellect.

words.ex: The cerebrum controls thinking and memory.
words.ex_cn: 大脑皮层控制思考和记忆。
words.en: The cerebrum is the largest part of the brain, responsible for voluntary activities and the processing of sensory information.

words.ex: The doctor checked her cervix during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 医生在检查时查看了她的宫颈。
