words.en: A nuisance is a person, thing, or situation that is annoying or causes trouble.

words.ex: The signature is null without a date.
words.ex_cn: 没有日期的签名是无效的。
words.en: Having no legal or binding force; completely void or invalid.

words.ex: The nun walks to the church every morning.
words.ex_cn: 修女每天早上步行去教堂。
words.en: A nun is a member of a female religious community, typically one living under vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience.

words.ex: Nutriology is the science of food and its effects on the body.
words.ex_cn: 营养学是研究食物及其对身体影响的科学。
words.en: Nutriology is the scientific study of food and drink, especially in terms of its effects on health.

words.ex: The patient was diagnosed with nyctalopia, making it difficult for him to see in low light conditions.
words.ex_cn: 患者被诊断为夜盲症，这使得他在低光条件下很难看清东西。
words.en: Nyctalopia, also known as night blindness, is a condition making it difficult or impossible to see in relatively low light. It is a symptom of several eye diseases. Nyctalopia may exist from birth, or be caused by injury or malnutrition (for example, a lack of vitamin A).

words.ex: He wears a nylon jacket to stay dry.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件尼龙夹克来保持干燥。
words.en: Nylon is a strong, elastic synthetic fiber used especially in the manufacture of clothing, ropes, and brushes.

words.tr: n. 蠢人；笨人；呆子；白痴
words.ex: The oaf dropped his plate on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 这个笨拙的人把盘子掉在了地上。
words.en: An oaf is a person who is clumsy, stupid, or uncultured.

words.ex: The oak tree stands tall in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 栎树矗立在后院。
words.en: An oak is a large tree that is common in northern countries. Oaks have strong wood and are often used for making furniture.

words.ex: He rowed the boat with an oar.
words.ex_cn: 他用桨划船。
words.en: An oar is a long pole with a wide, flat blade at one end, used for rowing a boat.

words.ex: The travelers found an oasis with water and trees.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者们发现了一个有水和树木的绿洲。
words.en: An oasis is a small area in a desert where water and plants are found, making it a place of relief and beauty in an otherwise barren landscape.

words.ex: He eats oat for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃燕麦当早餐。
words.en: A cereal plant cultivated chiefly in cool climates and widely used for animal feed as well as human consumption.

words.ex: He eats oatmeal for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃燕麦片当早餐。
words.en: Oatmeal is a type of coarse flour made of hulled oat grains that have either been milled or steel-cut. Ground oats are also called white oats. Steel-cut oats are known as coarse oatmeal, Irish oatmeal, or pinhead oats.

words.ex: He helped me obligingly with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他乐于助人地帮我做作业。
words.en: If you say that someone does something obligingly, you mean that they are willing and eager to help.

words.tr: v. 消灭；毁掉；清除；抹除
words.ex: The bomb will obliterate the building.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹会摧毁那栋大楼。
words.en: To obliterate something means to remove all signs of it or to destroy it completely.

words.tr: adj. 没注意到的；未觉察的；忘却的；
words.ex: He was oblivious to the noise around him.
words.ex_cn: 他对周围的噪音毫无察觉。
words.en: If you are oblivious to something or oblivious of it, you are not aware of it.

words.tr: adj. 过时的；废弃的；淘汰的；
words.ex: This phone is obsolete because it doesn't work with new apps.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机已经过时了，因为它不能使用新应用。
words.en: Something that is obsolete is no longer needed because something better has been invented.

words.ex: She works in obstetrics at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她在医院从事产科学工作。
words.en: The branch of medicine and surgery concerned with childbirth and the care of women giving birth.

words.tr: adj. 执拗的；固执的；顽固的；
words.ex: He is obstinate and won't change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他很执拗，不肯改变主意。
words.en: If you describe someone as obstinate, you are being critical of them because they are very determined to do what they want, and refuse to change their mind or be persuaded to do something else.

words.tr: adj. 钝的；愚钝的；钝角的
words.ex: The angle is obtuse, so it is larger than 90 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 这个角是钝的，所以它大于90度。
words.en: If you describe someone as obtuse, you mean that they are slow to understand things.

words.tr:
adj. 超自然的；神秘的；隐藏的
v. 掩蔽
n. 神秘的事物；神秘学
words.ex: He is interested in the occult.
words.ex_cn: 他对神秘学感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to mystical, supernatural, or magical powers, practices, or phenomena.

words.tr: n. 海洋学家；海洋学者
words.ex: He is an oceanographer who studies sea life.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名海洋学家，研究海洋生物。
words.en: An oceanographer is a scientist who studies the sea, including its physical and biological aspects.

words.ex: The octopus swims quickly in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 章鱼在海里游得很快。
words.en: An octopus is a sea creature with a soft, oval body and eight long arms.

words.tr:
adj. 眼睛的；视觉的
n. 目镜
words.ex: He wore ocular glasses to see better.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着眼镜以便看得更清楚。
words.en: Relating to the eye or vision.

words.tr: n. 几率；不利条件；不平等；
words.ex: The odds of winning the lottery are very low.
words.ex_cn: 中彩票的几率非常低。
words.en: The odds are the chances that a particular thing will happen.

words.ex: The officinal properties of this herb have been known for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这种草药的药用特性几个世纪以来一直为人所知。
words.en: Used or sold as a medicine; kept in stock by apothecaries.

words.tr: adj. 爱发号施令的；多管闲事的
words.ex: The officious clerk refused to help unless I filled out another form.
words.ex_cn: 那位爱多管闲事的职员拒绝帮忙，除非我再填一份表格。
words.en: If you describe someone as officious, you are critical of them because they are eager to tell people what to do when you think they should not.

words.ex: This wire has a resistance of 10 ohm.
words.ex_cn: 这条导线的电阻是10欧姆。
words.en: The ohm is the unit of electrical resistance in the International System of Units (SI). It is named after German physicist Georg Simon Ohm.

words.ex: The olfactory nerve helps us smell food.
words.ex_cn: 嗅神经帮助我们闻到食物的味道。
words.en: Relating to the sense of smell.

words.tr: n. 商品供应垄断；卖方市场
words.ex: The market is an oligopoly controlled by three big companies.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场由三家大公司控制，属于商品供应垄断。
words.en: An oligopoly is a state of limited competition, in which a market is shared by a small number of producers or sellers.

words.ex: The black cat is an omen of bad luck.
words.ex_cn: 黑猫是不祥之兆。
words.en: An omen is an event or phenomenon that is believed to foretell the future, often signifying the advent of change.

words.ex: The omission of his name was an accident.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字被漏掉是无意的。
words.en: An omission is something that has not been included or has not been done, either deliberately or accidentally.

words.tr: adj. 无所不在的；遍及各处的
words.ex: The smell of bread is omnipresent in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨面包的香味无处不在。
words.en: If you describe something as omnipresent, you mean that it seems to be everywhere at the same time.

words.ex: She specializes in oncology and treats many cancer patients.
words.ex_cn: 她专攻肿瘤学，治疗了许多癌症患者。
words.en: Oncology is the study and treatment of tumors.

words.ex: The onerous workload made her tired every day.
words.ex_cn: 繁重的工作量让她每天都很累。
words.en: If you describe a task as onerous, you dislike having to do it because you find it difficult or unpleasant.

words.ex: She wore a ring with an opal that sparkled in the light.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一枚镶有猫眼石的戒指，在光线下闪闪发亮。
words.en: A gemstone consisting of a form of hydrated silica, typically semi-transparent and showing many small points of shifting colour against a pale or dark ground.

words.ex: Ophthalmology is the branch of medicine that deals with the anatomy, physiology and diseases of the eye.
words.ex_cn: 眼科学是医学的一个分支，涉及眼睛的解剖学、生理学和疾病。
words.en: Ophthalmology is the branch of medicine concerned with the study and treatment of disorders and diseases of the eye.

words.tr:
n. 麻醉剂；鸦片制剂
adj. 含鸦片的；催眠性的
v. 加鸦片麻醉；使（感觉）迟钝；使缓和
words.ex: He took an opiate for his pain.
words.ex_cn: 他服了一种鸦片类药物来缓解疼痛。
words.en: An opiate is a drug that contains opium or a derivative of opium, used to relieve pain or induce sleep.

words.ex: He took opium for pain relief.
words.ex_cn: 他服用鸦片来缓解疼痛。
words.en: Opium is a powerful drug made from the juice of the opium poppy, which is used to relieve pain or to help people sleep.

words.tr: n. 眼镜商；验光师；眼镜商店
words.ex: He visited the optician to get new glasses.
words.ex_cn: 他去眼镜店配了新眼镜。
words.en: A person who makes or sells eyeglasses and other optical instruments.

words.ex: He is learning optics in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在物理课上学习光学。
words.en: Optics is the branch of physics that involves the study of light and its interactions with matter, including the construction of instruments that use or detect it.

words.ex: The optometrist checked my eyes last week.
words.ex_cn: 验光师上周检查了我的眼睛。
words.en: An optometrist is a person whose job is to examine people's eyes and to recommend and sell glasses.

words.ex: The oratorio was performed by a large choir.
words.ex_cn: 清唱剧由一个大合唱团表演。
words.en: An oratorio is a large musical composition for orchestra, choir, and soloists. Like an opera, an oratorio includes the use of a choir, soloists, an ensemble, various distinguishable characters, and arias. However, opera is musical theatre, while oratorio is strictly a concert piece.

words.tr:
n. 轨道；
v. 绕...轨道而行；
words.ex: The moon moves around the Earth in an orbit.
words.ex_cn: 月亮围绕地球在轨道上运行。
words.en: An orbit is the curved path, usually elliptical, described by a planet, satellite, spaceship, etc., around a celestial body, as the sun.

words.ex: He walks in the orchard every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在果园里散步。
words.en: An orchard is an area of land where fruit trees are grown.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.ex: She bought a pink orchid for her mother.
words.ex_cn: 她为母亲买了一朵粉色的兰花。
words.en: A plant with complex flowers that are often brightly coloured, grown especially for its beautiful flowers.

words.tr: n. 严酷的考验；痛苦的经历；煎熬
words.ex: He went through a long ordeal before he found peace.
words.ex_cn: 他在找到平静之前经历了一段漫长的磨难。
words.en: An ordeal is a very unpleasant and prolonged experience.

words.ex: She ordinarily wakes up at six o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 她通常六点起床。
words.en: In a usual or normal manner.

words.ex: The army stored old ordnance in a secure depot.
words.ex_cn: 军队把旧军械存放在一个安全的军火库中。
words.en: Military materials, such as weapons, ammunition, combat vehicles, and equipment.

words.ex: The miners dug deep to find iron ore.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们深入地下寻找铁矿石。
words.en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.

words.ex: The cell has many organelles that do different jobs.
words.ex_cn: 细胞有许多执行不同功能的细胞器。
words.en: An organelle is a specialized subunit within a cell that has a specific function, and is usually separately enclosed within its own lipid bilayer.

words.ex: The water flows through a small orifice.
words.ex_cn: 水通过一个小孔流出。
words.en: An orifice is an opening or hole, especially one in the body, such as a mouth or nostril.

words.tr: n. 矫形学；整形外科；骨科
words.ex: He works in orthopedics at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院从事骨科工作。
words.en: Orthopedics is the branch of medicine that deals with the correction of deformities of bones or muscles.

words.tr: n. 渗透；渗透作用；潜移默化
words.ex: Water moves by osmosis through a thin membrane.
words.ex_cn: 水通过半透膜以渗透的方式移动。
words.en: Osmosis is the process by which a liquid passes through a membrane from a less concentrated solution into a more concentrated one.

words.ex: The osprey is known for its ability to dive into water to catch fish.
words.ex_cn: 鹗以其潜入水中捕鱼的能力而闻名。
words.en: An osprey is a large fish-eating bird of prey with a white head and underparts and dark brown wings and back.

words.ex: He has a small osteoma on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的前额有一个小骨瘤。
words.en: A benign tumor composed of bone tissue.

words.ex: The ostrich runs very fast on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 鸵鸟在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: An ostrich is a large African bird that cannot fly and has long legs and a long neck.

words.ex: Otitis can be caused by bacterial or viral infections.
words.ex_cn: 耳炎可由细菌或病毒感染引起。
words.en: Inflammation of the ear, which can be classified by the part of the ear affected, such as otitis externa, otitis media, and otitis interna.

words.ex: She specialized in otorhinolaryngology after completing her medical degree.
words.ex_cn: 她在完成医学学位后专攻耳鼻喉科。
words.en: The branch of medicine that deals with the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and disorders of the ear, nose, and throat.

words.tr:
n. 亡命之徒；逃犯；被剥夺法律权益者
v. 宣布…为非法；使…成为非法
words.ex: The police caught the outlaw last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚抓住了那个不法之徒。
words.en: An outlaw is a person who has broken the law and who is hiding or running away to avoid punishment. To outlaw something means to make it illegal.

words.ex: He visits the hospital as an outpatient every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周作为门诊病人去医院。
words.en: A patient who receives medical treatment without being admitted to a hospital.

words.ex: The table has an oval shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是椭圆形的。
words.en: An oval is a shape that is like a circle but is longer in one direction than the other.

words.ex: The ovary produces eggs in women.
words.ex_cn: 卵巢在女性体内产生卵子。
words.en: The ovary is an organ in the female reproductive system that produces eggs.

words.tr: n. 成功欲望过强者；成绩超过预料的学生，成就比预期更大的人
words.ex: She's always been an over-achiever, excelling in both academics and sports.
words.ex_cn: 她一直是一个成就超过预期的人，在学术和体育方面都很出色。
words.en: An over-achiever is someone who performs better or achieves more success than expected.

words.tr: n. 过度活性；过度活动
words.ex: The child's overactivity in the classroom made it difficult for others to concentrate.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上过于活泼，使得其他人难以集中注意力。
words.en: Excessive or abnormal activity.

words.ex: The sky is overcast today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空多云。
words.en: If the sky or the day is overcast, it is covered with cloud; dull and not sunny.

words.tr:
n. 彻底检修；大修；彻底革新；全面修订
v. 彻底检修；超过（赛跑对手）
words.ex: The plane needs an overhaul before the next flight.
words.ex_cn: 这架飞机在下次飞行前需要彻底检修。
words.en: If you overhaul a system or method, you examine it carefully and make many changes in it in order to improve it.

words.ex: The car drove under the overpass.
words.ex_cn: 汽车从立交桥下开过。
words.en: An overpass is a bridge that carries one road or railway line over another.

words.ex: She put on an oversleeve to protect her blouse from stains.
words.ex_cn: 她戴上袖套以保护她的衬衫不被弄脏。
words.en: An oversleeve is a protective sleeve worn over clothing to protect it from dirt or damage.

words.ex: He worked overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: Overtime refers to the time worked beyond one's regular working hours, often with additional pay.

words.tr: adj. 累过头的，过度疲劳的
words.ex: He is overtired from working all night.
words.ex_cn: 他因为通宵工作而极度疲劳。
words.en: Exhausted from too much work or lack of sleep.

words.ex: The ovum is released from the ovary each month.
words.ex_cn: 卵子每月从卵巢释放。
words.en: An ovum is a female reproductive cell capable of developing into a new individual when fertilized by a male gamete.

words.ex: Rust is an oxide of iron.
words.ex_cn: 铁锈是铁的氧化物。
words.en: An oxide is a chemical compound that contains at least one oxygen atom and one other element in its chemical formula.

words.ex: The iron will oxidize in wet air.
words.ex_cn: 铁在潮湿的空气中会氧化。
words.en: To combine or become combined chemically with oxygen.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.ex: He ate a fresh oyster for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了一个新鲜的牡蛎。
words.en: An oyster is a large flat shellfish. Some oysters can be eaten and others produce valuable objects called pearls.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: Ozone is a form of oxygen that has three atoms in each molecule, and it is a pale blue gas with a pungent smell. It is found in the Earth's atmosphere and absorbs ultraviolet radiation, which is harmful to living organisms.

words.tr: n. 包装；装箱；包装物； v. “package”的现在分词；
words.ex: The packaging of the gift was very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这份礼物的包装非常漂亮。
words.en: The materials in which goods are wrapped or packed, especially commercially.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.ex: He picked up the paddle and rowed the boat.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起桨划船。
words.en: A paddle is a short pole with a wide flat part at one end or both ends, used to move a small boat through water.

words.tr: n. 露天历史剧；盛装游行（或庆典）；选美比赛
words.ex: The town held a pageant to show the history of the old kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇举办了一场露天历史剧，以展示古老王国的历史。
words.en: A pageant is a public entertainment consisting of a procession of people in elaborate, colorful costumes, or an outdoor performance of a historical scene.

words.ex: The pagoda stands on the hill near the temple.
words.ex_cn: 塔矗立在寺庙附近的山上。
words.en: A pagoda is a tiered tower with multiple eaves, built in traditions originating in East Asia or with respect to those traditions, most often Buddhist religious purposes.

words.ex: He filled the pail with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A pail is a bucket, usually made of metal or plastic, with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.ex: He wears pajamas to bed every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上穿睡衣睡觉。
words.en: Pajamas are loose-fitting clothes worn for sleeping, consisting of trousers and a jacket.

words.tr:
n. 朋友；伙伴
v. 结为伙伴
words.ex: He is my best pal.
words.ex_cn: 他是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A pal is a friend or companion.

words.tr: n. 上腭；味觉；审美眼光；嗜好；爱好
words.ex: The roof of the mouth is called the palate.
words.ex_cn: 口腔的顶部被称为上腭。
words.en: The palate refers to the roof of the mouth in humans and other mammals, separating the oral cavity from the nasal cavity. It also refers to a person's ability to distinguish between and appreciate different flavors.

words.ex: The painter arranged his colors on the palette.
words.ex_cn: 画家把颜色放在调色板上。
words.en: A palette is a flat piece of wood, plastic, etc., on which an artist mixes paints.

words.tr:
n. 治标药物；缓解剂
adj. 减轻的；缓和的；治标的
words.ex: The doctor prescribed a palliative to reduce his pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一种治标药物来减轻他的疼痛。
words.en: A palliative is a drug or medical treatment that relieves suffering without dealing with the cause of the suffering.

words.ex: The patient's pallor was alarming.
words.ex_cn: 病人的脸色苍白得吓人。
words.en: If you refer to the pallor of someone's face or skin, you mean that it is pale and unhealthy-looking.

words.ex: The doctor performed a thorough palpation of the abdomen.
words.ex_cn: 医生对腹部进行了彻底的触诊。
words.en: The act of examining the body by touch, especially for medical diagnosis.

words.ex: Her heart palpitated with excitement.
words.ex_cn: 她的心脏因兴奋而悸动。
words.en: If your heart palpitates, it beats very fast and in an irregular way, usually because you are anxious or frightened.

words.ex: He has palsy in his right hand.
words.ex_cn: 他的右手有麻痹。
words.en: Palsy is a condition marked by uncontrollable tremor or paralysis of a part of the body.

words.ex: He handed me a pamphlet about the new park.
words.ex_cn: 他递给我一份关于新公园的小册子。
words.en: A pamphlet is a small book containing information on a particular subject or expressing political or religious views.

words.ex: He ate a pancake for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一块煎饼。
words.en: A pancake is a thin, flat, round cake prepared from a batter and cooked on a hot griddle or frying pan.

words.ex: The pancreas makes insulin to control blood sugar.
words.ex_cn: 胰腺分泌胰岛素来控制血糖。
words.en: The pancreas is a large gland behind the stomach which secretes digestive enzymes into the duodenum. Embedded in the pancreas are the islets of Langerhans, which secrete into the blood the hormones insulin and glucagon.

words.ex: The window has a broken pane.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户有一块碎了的玻璃。
words.en: A pane is a piece of glass that is fitted into a window or door.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.tr:
v. 喘气；喘息
n. 气喘；喘息
words.ex: He panted after running up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他跑上楼梯后喘着气。
words.en: To breathe quickly and loudly through your mouth, usually because you have been doing something energetic.

words.ex: The panther walks quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 美洲豹静静地穿过森林。
words.en: A panther is a large wild animal of the cat family, which is either black or tawny-colored with black spots and is found in Africa, Asia, and the Americas.

words.tr: n. 食品贮藏室；食品贮藏柜
words.ex: She keeps cookies in the pantry.
words.ex_cn: 她把饼干放在食品储藏室里。
words.en: A pantry is a small room or closet in a house, usually near the kitchen, where food, dishes, linens, and provisions are stored.

words.tr:
n. 长裤子；短内裤； “pant”的复数
v. 喘气；喘息；“pant”的第三人称单数
words.ex: He is wearing blue pants.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Pants are a piece of clothing that covers the body from the waist to the ankles and divides into two parts to cover each leg separately.

words.tr: n. 乳头；无价值的读物；半流质食物
words.ex: The baby was fed with pap after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 手术后，婴儿被喂了半流质食物。
words.en: A soft food for infants or invalids, typically made from bread or flour and milk.

words.ex: The dermatologist identified several papulae on the patient's skin.
words.ex_cn: 皮肤科医生在患者的皮肤上发现了几个丘疹。
words.en: A small, raised, solid pimple or swelling, often forming part of a rash on the skin and typically inflamed but not producing pus.

words.ex: Ancient Egyptians wrote on papyrus.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人在纸莎草纸上写字。
words.en: Papyrus is a material similar to thick paper that was used in ancient times as a writing surface. It was made from the pith of the papyrus plant, Cyperus papyrus, a wetland sedge.

words.ex: This experiment is a paradigm of scientific method.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验是科学方法的范例。
words.en: A paradigm is a model or pattern that is considered to be a typical example of something.

words.ex: He is a paragon of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他是诚实的典范。
words.en: A paragon is someone who is considered to be a perfect example of a particular quality.

words.tr: v. 使麻痹；使瘫痪；使无效；使停止活动
words.ex: The accident paralyzed his leg.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他的腿瘫痪了。
words.en: If someone is paralyzed by an accident or an illness, they have no feeling in their body, or in part of their body, and are unable to move.

words.ex: The accident caused paralysis in his legs.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故导致他双腿瘫痪。
words.en: Paralysis is the loss of the ability to move and sometimes to feel anything in part or most of the body, typically as a result of illness, poison, or injury.

words.ex: The teacher changed the parameter to make the test easier.
words.ex_cn: 老师更改了参数，使测试更容易。
words.en: A parameter is a limit or boundary which defines the scope of a particular process or activity.

words.ex: He is researching parapsychology to understand telepathy.
words.ex_cn: 他正在研究超心理学以理解心灵感应。
words.en: The study of mental phenomena that are excluded from or inexplicable by orthodox scientific psychology.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.ex: The parasitic worm lives inside the host.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主体内。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a parasite; living on or in another organism and deriving nutrients at the host's expense.

words.tr: adj. 非肠道的；肠胃外的
words.ex: The doctor prescribed a parenteral solution to bypass the digestive system.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一种肠胃外溶液，以绕过消化系统。
words.en: Parenteral refers to the administration of substances into the body by means other than through the digestive tract, typically by injection.

words.tr: n. 被社会遗弃者；贱民；底层民众
words.ex: He felt like a pariah in the community after the scandal.
words.ex_cn: 丑闻之后，他在社区里感觉像个贱民。
words.en: A pariah is someone who is not accepted by a particular group, especially because they are believed to have done something wrong or unacceptable.

words.tr: n. 教区；堂区；行政小区；
words.ex: The priest serves in a small parish.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在一个小教区服务。
words.en: A parish is a small administrative district typically having its own church and a priest or pastor.

words.ex: She wore a parisian style hat.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一顶巴黎风格的帽子。
words.en: Of or relating to Paris or its inhabitants.

words.tr: n. 客厅；起居室；营业室
words.ex: They sat in the parlor and drank tea.
words.ex_cn: 他们坐在客厅里喝茶。
words.en: A parlor is a room in a house for the special use of visitors, or a room in a public building for a specific purpose.

words.tr: n. 客厅；起居室；营业室
words.ex: She sat in the parlour and drank tea.
words.ex_cn: 她坐在客厅里喝茶。
words.en: A parlour is a room in a house for the special use of entertaining guests, reading, or other activities.

words.tr: adj. 教区的；地方范围的；思想狭隘的
words.ex: The priest served in a small parochial church.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在一座小型教区教堂服务。
words.en: If you describe someone as parochial, you are criticizing them because you think they are too concerned with their own affairs and should be thinking about more important things.

words.tr: n. 突然发作；激发；阵发
words.ex: She experienced a paroxysm of coughing during the night.
words.ex_cn: 她在夜里经历了一次剧烈的咳嗽发作。
words.en: A paroxysm is a sudden attack or outburst of a particular emotion or activity.

words.ex: Dust particles float in the air.
words.ex_cn: 灰尘微粒漂浮在空气中。
words.en: A particle is a very small piece or amount of something.

words.tr:
n. 划分；隔离物；分割
v. 分开；隔开
words.ex: The partition of the room made it more private.
words.ex_cn: 房间的隔断让它更私密了。
words.en: A partition is a wall, screen, or divider that separates one part of a room, vehicle, or other space from another.

words.ex: He drew a flower with pastel.
words.ex_cn: 他用彩色粉笔画了一朵花。
words.en: Pastel can refer to a type of soft, colored chalk used for drawing, or to a drawing made with such chalks. It can also describe colors that are pale and soft.

words.ex: The cows graze in the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Pasture is land covered with grass where animals such as cows and sheep can graze.

words.ex: The pathogen caused the outbreak of the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种病原体引发了疾病的爆发。
words.en: A pathogen is any organism or substance, especially a microorganism, capable of causing disease, such as bacteria, viruses, protozoa, or fungi.

words.tr: adj. 能引起疾病的；病原的；
words.ex: The pathogenic bacteria made him sick.
words.ex_cn: 这些致病细菌让他生病了。
words.en: Capable of causing disease.

words.tr: adj. 病理学的；病理的；病态的
words.ex: The doctor found a pathological change in the tissue.
words.ex_cn: 医生在组织中发现了一种病理性的变化。
words.en: Pathological means relating to pathology, which is the study of diseases, or it can describe a behavior or condition that is extreme and not normal, often in a way that is harmful or undesirable.

words.ex: He is studying pathology to understand diseases.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习病理学以了解疾病。
words.en: Pathology is the study of the causes and effects of diseases, especially the branch of medicine that deals with the laboratory examination of samples of body tissue for diagnostic or forensic purposes.

words.ex: Understanding pathophysiology is crucial for diagnosing and treating diseases.
words.ex_cn: 理解病理生理学对于诊断和治疗疾病至关重要。
words.en: The study of the disordered physiological processes associated with disease or injury.

words.ex: The patriarch leads his large family with wisdom.
words.ex_cn: 这位族长以智慧领导他的大家庭。
words.en: A patriarch is a man who is the head of a family or tribe, or a highly respected man in a particular field.

words.ex: He is a true patriot who loves his country.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位真正热爱祖国的爱国者。
words.en: A patriot is someone who loves their country and is willing to defend it against enemies or detractors.

words.ex: The company received patronage from a local businessman.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司收到了一位本地商人的赞助。
words.en: The support, encouragement, privilege, or financial aid that an organization or individual bestows to another.

words.tr:
adj. 自以为高人一等的；屈尊俯就的
v. 惠顾；资助；屈尊俯就；“patronize”的现在分词
words.ex: He gave a patronizing smile when she asked a simple question.
words.ex_cn: 当她问了一个简单的问题时，他露出了居高临下的微笑。
words.en: If someone is patronizing, they speak or behave towards you in a way that seems friendly, but which shows that they think they are superior to you.

words.ex: There is a paucity of water in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很少。
words.en: If you say that there is a paucity of something, you mean that there is not enough of it.

words.ex: The pauper lived in a small hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个穷人住在一间小屋里。
words.en: A pauper is someone who is extremely poor and has very little money or possessions.

words.ex: The fans sat in the pavilion to watch the game.
words.ex_cn: 观众坐在看台上观看比赛。
words.en: A pavilion is a building or tent used for a specific purpose, such as entertainment or exhibitions, often found in parks or at fairs.

words.ex: He left his watch as a pawn at the shop.
words.ex_cn: 他把手表当成了典当品放在店里。
words.en: To pawn something means to leave it with a pawnbroker, who lends you money in exchange. The pawnbroker keeps the item until you pay back the money plus interest.

words.tr: n. 付薪水的支票；薪水
words.ex: He gets his paycheck every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A paycheck is a check that an employee receives from their employer as payment for their work.

words.tr: adj. 教育学的；教学法的
words.ex: The teacher used pedagogic methods to help students learn.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师使用了教学法来帮助学生学习。
words.en: Pedagogic relates to the methods and theory of teaching.

words.ex: The teacher learned new pedagogy from the workshop.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师从研讨会中学到了新的教学法。
words.en: The method and practice of teaching, especially as an academic subject or theoretical concept.

words.tr: n. 流动小贩；商贩；传播者
words.ex: The peddler sells toys on the street.
words.ex_cn: 小贩在街上卖玩具。
words.en: A peddler is someone who goes from place to place trying to sell small goods.

words.ex: He became a doctor in pediatrics after years of study.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的学习，他成为了儿科学医生。
words.en: Pediatrics is the branch of medicine that involves the medical care of infants, children, and adolescents.

words.tr: n. 流动小贩；商贩；传播者
words.ex: The pedlar sells toys on the street.
words.ex_cn: 小贩在街上卖玩具。
words.en: A pedlar is someone who goes from place to place selling small goods.

words.tr:
n. 钉；支柱
v. 钉（木桩等）以固定；限定
words.ex: He hung the hat on a peg.
words.ex_cn: 他把帽子挂在了一个钉子上。
words.en: A peg is a small device, usually made of wood or metal, that is used to fasten things or to hang things on.

words.ex: The pelvis supports the spine and protects internal organs.
words.ex_cn: 骨盆支撑脊柱并保护内脏。
words.en: The pelvis is the large bony structure near the base of the spine to which the hind limbs or legs are attached in humans and many other vertebrates.

words.ex: He has a penchant for sweet food.
words.ex_cn: 他偏爱甜食。
words.en: A penchant is a strong liking or taste for something.

words.tr:
n. 垂饰；悬挂物
adj. 吊着的；悬垂的；悬而未决的
words.ex: She wears a silver pendant around her neck.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一条银色吊坠在脖子上。
words.en: A pendant is a piece of jewelry that hangs from a chain worn around the neck.

words.ex: The pendulum swings back and forth in the clock.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆在钟里来回摆动。
words.en: A pendulum is a weight that is hung from a fixed point so that it can swing freely, especially a rod with a weight at the end that regulates the mechanism of a clock.

words.ex: The doctor gave him penicillin for his infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了青霉素治疗感染。
words.en: An antibiotic drug obtained from molds or produced synthetically, used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

words.ex: The peninsula is surrounded by water on three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个半岛三面环水。
words.en: A peninsula is a piece of land that is almost entirely surrounded by water but is connected to the mainland on one side.

words.ex: Pepsin is a digestive enzyme produced in the stomach.
words.ex_cn: 胃蛋白酶是一种在胃中产生的消化酶。
words.en: An enzyme that breaks down proteins into peptides in the stomach.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed a peptic medication to aid digestion.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一种助消化的药物来帮助消化。
words.en: Relating to or aiding digestion.

words.tr:
n. 栖枝；鲈鱼；
v. 栖息；处于（高处）；
words.ex: The bird sat on a perch near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟停在树旁的一根栖枝上。
words.en: A perch is a branch or rod where a bird rests or a high position where someone or something is located. As a verb, it means to rest or be located in a high position.

words.ex: The doctor percussed the patient's chest to check for any irregularities.
words.ex_cn: 医生轻敲病人的胸部以检查是否有任何异常。
words.en: To percuss means to tap or strike something, especially as part of a medical examination to check the condition of the body.

words.ex: He plays the drum, a type of percussion.
words.ex_cn: 他演奏鼓，一种打击乐器。
words.en: Percussion refers to musical instruments that are played by being struck or shaken, such as drums, cymbals, or tambourines. It can also refer to the act of striking or hitting something.

words.ex: The doctor used a percutaneous needle to collect the sample.
words.ex_cn: 医生用经皮针采集了样本。
words.en: Percutaneous refers to a medical procedure where access to inner organs or other tissue is done via needle puncture of the skin, rather than by using an 'open' approach where inner organs or tissue are exposed.

words.tr: adj. 多年生的；反复出现的；
words.ex: These perennial flowers bloom every year.
words.ex_cn: 这些多年生的花每年都会开花。
words.en: A perennial plant is one that lives for more than two years, often flowering and producing seeds multiple times over its lifespan.

words.ex: The climb was perilous in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 在暴风雨中，这次攀登非常危险。
words.en: Full of danger or risk.

words.ex: The fence marks the perimeter of the garden.
words.ex_cn: 围栏标出了花园的边界。
words.en: The perimeter of an area or object is the total length of its sides or outer boundary.

words.ex: The keyboard is a peripheral device.
words.ex_cn: 键盘是一个外围设备。
words.en: A peripheral activity or issue is one that is not very important compared with other activities or issues.

words.ex: The small village lies on the periphery of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于城市的外围。
words.en: The outer limits or edge of an area or object.

words.ex: He was charged with perjury after lying in court.
words.ex_cn: 他在法庭上撒谎后被控伪证罪。
words.en: The crime of telling a lie in a court of law after having sworn to tell the truth.

words.ex: Free lunch is a perk of this job.
words.ex_cn: 免费午餐是这份工作的一个额外补贴。
words.en: If someone perks up or if something perks them up, they become more cheerful or lively.

words.tr: adj. 有害的；恶性的；致命的
words.ex: Smoking is a pernicious habit.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟是一种有害的习惯。
words.en: Having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or subtle way.

words.tr:
adj. 垂直的；笔直的
n. 垂直线
words.ex: The lines are perpendicular to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些线互相垂直。
words.en: At right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line; vertical.

words.ex: His perseverance helped him finish the marathon.
words.ex_cn: 他的毅力帮助他完成了马拉松。
words.en: Perseverance is the quality of continuing to try to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties.

words.tr: n. （文章语言表达等的）明晰；简明
words.ex: The perspicuity of her writing made it easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 她写作的明晰性使得文章易于理解。
words.en: The quality of being clear and easy to understand.

words.ex: He perspires heavily when he runs.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时大量出汗。
words.en: To perspire means to produce liquid through your skin because you are hot or frightened.

words.ex: His pessimism made him expect the worst.
words.ex_cn: 他的悲观主义让他总是预期最坏的结果。
words.en: Pessimism is the belief that bad things are going to happen or that something is going to turn out badly.

words.tr: n. 悲观主义者；悲观论者
words.ex: He is a pessimist who always expects the worst.
words.ex_cn: 他是个悲观者，总是预期最坏的结果。
words.en: A pessimist is someone who always expects that bad things will happen.

words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.ex: The village was destroyed by pestilence last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个村庄被瘟疫摧毁了。
words.en: A pestilence is a fatal epidemic disease, especially bubonic plague.

words.tr: adj. 致死的；有害的；传染的
words.ex: The pestilential conditions in the refugee camp led to a rapid spread of disease.
words.ex_cn: 难民营中引起瘟疫的条件导致了疾病的迅速传播。
words.en: Pestilential is used to describe something that is harmful or destructive, especially in a way that is difficult to control or stop.

words.ex: The rose has five pink petals.
words.ex_cn: 这朵玫瑰有五片粉红色的花瓣。
words.en: A petal is one of the colored parts of a flower that are often shaped like a leaf and grow in a circle around the center.

words.ex: The pharaoh built a big pyramid.
words.ex_cn: 法老建造了一座巨大的金字塔。
words.en: A pharaoh was a king in ancient Egypt, considered a god as well as a political leader.

words.tr:
adj. 制药的；配药的；
n. 药物；
words.ex: He works at a pharmaceutical company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家制药公司工作。
words.en: relating to the production and sale of medicinal drugs

words.ex: The pharmacist gave me medicine for my cough.
words.ex_cn: 药剂师给了我治咳嗽的药。
words.en: A pharmacist is a person who is qualified to prepare and dispense medicinal drugs.

words.ex: He studies pharmacology to understand how drugs work.
words.ex_cn: 他学习药理学以了解药物如何发挥作用。
words.en: Pharmacology is the branch of medicine concerned with the uses, effects, and modes of action of drugs.

words.ex: He has pharyngitis and can't swallow well.
words.ex_cn: 他患有咽炎，吞咽困难。
words.en: Inflammation of the pharynx, causing a sore throat.

words.ex: The doctor used a pharyngoscope to examine the patient's throat.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用咽镜检查病人的喉咙。
words.en: An instrument for inspecting the pharynx.

words.ex: The pharynx is a muscular tube that connects the mouth to the esophagus.
words.ex_cn: 咽是一个连接口腔和食道的肌肉管。
words.en: The pharynx is the part of the throat that is behind the mouth and nasal cavity and above the esophagus and the larynx, which is the passage that leads to the stomach and the lungs.

words.ex: Ants leave a pheromone trail to find their way home.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁留下信息素痕迹来找到回家的路。
words.en: A pheromone is a chemical substance produced and released into the environment by an animal, especially a mammal or an insect, affecting the behavior or physiology of others of its species.

words.tr: adj. 慈善的；乐善好施的；
words.ex: He made a philanthropic donation to help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他捐赠了一笔慈善款项来帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A philanthropic person or organization freely gives money or other help to people who need it.

words.ex: The philharmonic played a symphony last night.
words.ex_cn: 交响乐团昨晚演奏了一首交响曲。
words.en: Relating to a symphony orchestra or to the performance of orchestral music.

words.tr: n. 语文学；语言学；文献学
words.ex: He loves philology because it helps him understand old texts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱语言学，因为它帮助他理解古文。
words.en: Philology is the study of language in written historical sources; it is a combination of literary studies, history and linguistics.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: The teacher used phonetic symbols to help students pronounce words correctly.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用语音符号帮助学生正确发音。
words.en: Phonetic means relating to the sounds of speech or the study of these sounds.

words.tr:
adj. 假的；冒充的；欺骗的
n. 骗子；伪君子；假货
words.ex: He gave a phony excuse for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个虚假的借口来解释迟到。
words.en: If you describe something as phony, you disapprove of it because it is false rather than genuine.

words.ex: The plant needs phosphate to grow well.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要磷酸盐才能良好生长。
words.en: A phosphate is a salt or ester of phosphoric acid, containing the anion PO₄³⁻ or the group —PO₄.

words.ex: Phosphorus is in some fertilizers.
words.ex_cn: 磷存在于一些肥料中。
words.en: Phosphorus is a chemical element with the symbol P and atomic number 15. It is a nonmetal that is essential for life, found in DNA, RNA, ATP, and the phospholipids that form all cell membranes.

words.ex: The photoelectric cell converts light into electricity.
words.ex_cn: 光电管将光转化为电能。
words.en: Relating to the electrical effects of light, especially the emission of electrons from a surface when exposed to light.

words.ex: Plants use sunlight for photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 植物利用阳光进行光合作用。
words.en: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants and some other organisms use sunlight to synthesize foods from carbon dioxide and water.

words.ex: The house uses photovoltaic panels to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子使用光伏板来发电。
words.en: relating to the production of electric current at the junction of two substances exposed to light

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.ex: His physiological response to stress is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 他对压力的生理反应非常强烈。
words.en: Physiological refers to the normal functions of living organisms and their parts, or to the branch of biology that deals with these functions.

words.ex: He studies physiology to understand how the human body works.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生理学以了解人体如何运作。
words.en: The branch of biology that deals with the normal functions of living organisms and their parts.

words.tr:
n. 尖木桩；警戒哨；纠察队（队员）
v. 进行罢工纠察
words.ex: The fence has wooden pickets to keep animals out.
words.ex_cn: 这个围栏有木制尖木桩，用来防止动物进入。
words.en: A picket is a person or group of people who stand outside a place of work or other venue to protest or to try to persuade others not to enter during a strike. It can also refer to a pointed stake or post driven into the ground, typically to form a fence or to tether a horse.

words.tr:
n. 泡菜；腌菜；腌汁；腌制品；困境
v. 腌制（泡菜等）
words.ex: He put a pickle on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上放了一颗酸黄瓜。
words.en: A pickle is a vegetable or fruit that has been preserved in vinegar or salt water, or a difficult situation.

words.tr:
adj. 有图画的；图示的
n. 画报
words.ex: The book has a pictorial guide to plants.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一本植物的图解指南。
words.en: A pictorial representation or image is one that is made using pictures or shows things in a way that pictures do.

words.tr:
adj. 零碎的；
adv. 零碎地；
words.ex: He fixed the car piecemeal, one part at a time.
words.ex_cn: 他一点一点地修理汽车，一次修一个零件。
words.en: If you describe a change or process as piecemeal, you disapprove of it because it happens gradually, usually at irregular intervals, and is probably not satisfactory.

words.ex: The fisherman walked to the pier to check his nets.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫走到码头去检查他的渔网。
words.en: A pier is a platform sticking out into water, usually the sea, which people walk along or use when getting onto or off boats.

words.tr:
n. 鸽笼式分类架
v. 分类
words.ex: He put the letter in a pigeonhole.
words.ex_cn: 他把信放进了一个小隔间里。
words.en: A pigeonhole is one of the sections in a frame on a wall where letters and messages can be left for someone, or one of the sections in a writing desk where you can keep documents. To pigeonhole someone or something means to decide that they belong to a particular class or category, often without considering all their qualities or characteristics.

words.ex: The pigment in leaves changes color in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 叶子中的色素在秋天会变色。
words.en: A pigment is a substance that gives something a particular color.

words.ex: The boy cleaned the dirty pigsty with a shovel.
words.ex_cn: 男孩用铲子清理了脏乱的猪圈。
words.en: A pigsty is a place where pigs are kept, which is often very dirty and untidy.

words.ex: The pilgrim walked to the holy place.
words.ex_cn: 朝圣者步行前往圣地。
words.en: A pilgrim is a person who journeys to a sacred place for religious reasons.

words.ex: He contracted pinkeye after swimming in the contaminated pool.
words.ex_cn: 他在受污染的泳池游泳后患上了红眼病。
words.en: Pinkeye, also known as conjunctivitis, is an inflammation or infection of the transparent membrane (conjunctiva) that lines your eyelid and covers the white part of your eyeball.

words.ex: He held a pistol in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着一把手枪。
words.en: A pistol is a small gun.

words.ex: The piston moves up and down in the engine.
words.ex_cn: 活塞在发动机中上下移动。
words.en: A piston is a component of reciprocating engines, reciprocating pumps, gas compressors and pneumatic cylinders, among other similar mechanisms. It is the moving component that is contained by a cylinder and is made gas-tight by piston rings.

words.ex: The dog fell into a deep pit.
words.ex_cn: 狗掉进了一个深坑。
words.en: A pit is a large hole in the ground, either natural or as a result of digging. It can also refer to a hollow or indentation in a surface, or a place where something is extracted, such as a mine. As a verb, to pit means to set someone or something in competition or to make a hollow or indentation in a surface.

words.ex: The pitcher threw the ball fast.
words.ex_cn: 投掷的人把球投得很快。
words.en: A pitcher is a player in baseball who throws the ball to the batter. It can also refer to a large container with a handle and a lip, used for holding and pouring liquids.

words.ex: The pitiable dog had no home.
words.ex_cn: 那只可怜的狗没有家。
words.en: Deserving or arousing pity.

words.ex: The pituitary controls growth in the body.
words.ex_cn: 脑垂体控制身体的生长。
words.en: The pituitary is a small gland at the base of the brain that produces hormones affecting growth and the functions of other glands in the body.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a placebo to see if his pain would go away.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一个安慰剂，看看他的疼痛是否会消失。
words.en: A substance that has no therapeutic effect, used as a control in testing new drugs, or given for its psychological effect to a patient who believes it to be a medicine.

words.ex: The placenta plays a crucial role in nutrient exchange during pregnancy.
words.ex_cn: 胎盘在怀孕期间的养分交换中起着至关重要的作用。
words.en: The placenta is an organ that develops in the uterus during pregnancy, providing oxygen and nutrients to the growing baby and removing waste products from the baby's blood.

words.ex: He was punished for plagiarism in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他因论文剽窃而受到惩罚。
words.en: Plagiarism is the practice of using or copying someone else's idea or work and pretending that you thought of it or created it.

words.tr: adj. 直言不讳的；直截了当的
words.ex: He was known for his plainspoken manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以说话直率著称。
words.en: If someone is plainspoken, they say exactly what they think, without trying to make their opinions sound more polite or acceptable than they really are.

words.ex: Plankton float in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 浮游生物漂浮在海洋中。
words.en: Plankton are the diverse collection of organisms found in water (or air) that are unable to propel themselves against a current (or wind).

words.ex: The farmer worked on the plantation every day.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天在耕地上劳作。
words.en: A plantation is a large piece of land, especially in a tropical country, where crops such as coffee, sugar, rubber, or tobacco are grown.

words.tr: n. 匾额；饰板；薄金属板；齿菌斑
words.ex: The plaque on the wall honors the founder of the school.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的匾额纪念这所学校的创始人。
words.en: A plaque is a flat piece of metal or stone with writing on it that is fixed to a wall or other structure to remind people of an important person or event.

words.ex: The doctor tested his plasma for antibodies.
words.ex_cn: 医生检测了他的血浆中的抗体。
words.en: Plasma is the clear, straw-colored liquid portion of blood that remains after red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets and other cellular components are removed. It is the single largest component of human blood, comprising about 55 percent, and contains water, salts, enzymes, antibodies and other proteins.

words.tr:
n. 灰泥；
v. 涂以灰泥；敷以膏药；
words.ex: The wall was covered with white plaster.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁上覆盖着白色灰泥。
words.en: A substance applied to walls or ceilings to smooth or decorate them, or a medical dressing used to cover wounds.

words.ex: The doctor checked his platelet count.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的血小板计数。
words.en: A platelet is a small colorless disk-shaped cell fragment without a nucleus, found in large numbers in blood and involved in clotting.

words.tr: n. 陈词滥调；老生常谈；
words.ex: His speech was full of platitudes about hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲充满了关于努力工作的陈词滥调。
words.en: A platitude is a statement that has been used so often that it is meaningless and shows a lack of original thought.

words.tr:
adj. 全体参加的；无限的；完全的
n. 全会；全体会议
words.ex: The plenary session started at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 全体会议在上午九点开始。
words.en: A plenary session or meeting is one that is attended by everyone who has the right to attend.

words.ex: The pleura is a thin membrane that surrounds the lungs.
words.ex_cn: 胸膜是一层包裹着肺部的薄膜。
words.en: The pleura is a thin layer of tissue that covers the lungs and lines the interior wall of the chest cavity. It helps to protect and cushion the lungs.

words.tr: n. （血管、淋巴管、神经等的）丛
words.ex: The aortic plexus is a network of nerves surrounding the aorta.
words.ex_cn: 主动脉丛是围绕主动脉的神经网络。
words.en: A plexus is a network of nerves or vessels in the body.

words.tr:
n. 犁；犁形器具
v. 犁；耕；艰苦前进
words.ex: The farmer uses a plow to turn the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用犁翻土。
words.en: A plow is a farm tool with one or more heavy blades that breaks the soil and cuts a furrow for sowing seeds.

words.ex: The bird's plumage was a vibrant mix of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟的羽毛色彩鲜艳。
words.en: The feathers covering the body of a bird.

words.ex: The plumber fixed the leaky pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了漏水的管道。
words.en: A plumber is a person whose job is to connect and repair things such as water and drainage pipes, baths, and toilets.

words.ex: The apple plummeted from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上垂直落下。
words.en: If an amount, rate, or price plummets, it decreases quickly by a large amount.

words.tr:
adj. 气动的；风动的；充气的
n. 气胎
words.ex: The pneumatic drill makes loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 气动钻发出很大的噪音。
words.en: Pneumatic means relating to or operated by air or gas under pressure.

words.ex: He got pneumonia after a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他得了重感冒后患了肺炎。
words.en: Pneumonia is a serious disease which affects your lungs and makes it difficult for you to breathe.

words.tr: n. 小笔记本；钱夹；袖珍本；财力
words.ex: He wrote the phone number in his pocketbook.
words.ex_cn: 他把电话号码写在了他的小笔记本里。
words.en: A pocketbook is a small book, especially one that can be carried in a pocket, or a woman's handbag.

words.ex: Bees collect pollen from flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂从花朵中采集花粉。
words.en: Pollen is a fine powder produced by flowers, which is carried by the wind or insects to other flowers of the same species, causing them to produce seeds.

words.ex: Bees pollinate flowers in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂给花园里的花授粉。
words.en: To pollinate means to transfer pollen from the male part of a flower to the female part, enabling fertilization and the production of seeds.

words.ex: Bees are important pollinators for flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂是花朵的重要传粉者。
words.en: A pollinator is an animal that moves pollen from the male part of a flower to the female part of a flower, thus enabling fertilization and the production of seeds.

words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.ex: He drew a pentagon, which is a polygon.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个五边形，它是一个多边形。
words.en: A polygon is a flat shape with three or more straight sides and angles.

words.tr: adj. 多边形的；多角形的
words.ex: The building's design features a polygonal facade.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的设计特点是多边形的外墙。
words.en: Having the shape or form of a polygon; consisting of polygons.

words.ex: The bottle is made of a strong polymer.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是由一种坚固的聚合物制成的。
words.en: A polymer is a chemical compound with molecules bonded together in long repeating chains. Because of their structure, polymers have unique properties that can be tailored for different uses.

words.ex: The polyp lives in the ocean and attaches to rocks.
words.ex_cn: 水螅生活在海洋中，附着在岩石上。
words.en: A polyp is a small growth, usually benign, protruding from a mucous membrane.

words.tr: n. 工艺专科学院；理工专科学院；
words.ex: He enrolled in a polytechnic to learn engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他进入了一所工艺专科学院学习工程。
words.en: A polytechnic is an institution of higher education offering courses in many subjects, especially vocational or technical subjects.

words.tr: adj. 沉重的；笨重的；沉闷的
words.ex: He carried a ponderous box across the room.
words.ex_cn: 他搬着一个沉重的箱子穿过房间。
words.en: Something that is ponderous is very heavy or is very slow and clumsy because of its weight or size.

words.ex: She baked a batch of cornbread pones.
words.ex_cn: 她烤了一批玉米饼。
words.en: A misspelling or variant of 'pone,' a type of cornbread or a term for a bet in some games.

words.ex: He's always the pooper at parties.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在派对上扫兴。
words.en: A person who defecates; someone who spoils the enjoyment of others.

words.ex: The pope speaks to millions of people every year.
words.ex_cn: 教皇每年向数百万人讲话。
words.en: The Pope is the bishop of Rome and the leader of the worldwide Catholic Church.

words.ex: The rise of populism in recent years has been a significant political phenomenon.
words.ex_cn: 近年来平民主义的兴起是一个重要的政治现象。
words.en: Populism is a political approach that strives to appeal to ordinary people who feel that their concerns are disregarded by established elite groups.

words.ex: He bought a porcelain cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个瓷杯。
words.en: A hard, white, translucent ceramic that is made by firing a pure clay and then glazing it.

words.ex: He sits on the porch and drinks coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在门廊上喝咖啡。
words.en: A porch is a covered shelter projecting in front of the entrance of a building.

words.ex: The porcupine is known for its sharp quills.
words.ex_cn: 豪猪以其尖锐的刺而闻名。
words.en: A porcupine is a rodent with a coat of sharp spines, or quills, that defend it from predators.

words.ex: Dark clouds portend a storm.
words.ex_cn: 乌云预示着一场风暴。
words.en: If something portends something else, it indicates that it is likely to happen in the future.

words.ex: He is doing a postdoctoral research at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他正在哈佛做博士后研究。
words.en: Relating to or denoting research undertaken after completing a PhD.

words.tr: adj. （时间、次序）较后的；后面的；背面的；
words.ex: The posterior chapter explains the final result.
words.ex_cn: 后面的章节解释了最终结果。
words.en: Located behind a part or toward the rear of something.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.tr: adj. 死后的；死后出版的；遗腹的
words.ex: He received a posthumous award for his bravery.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢而被追授了奖项。
words.en: Posthumous means occurring, awarded, or appearing after the death of the originator.

words.ex: The city became post-industrial after the factories closed.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭后，这座城市进入了后工业时代。
words.en: relating to or denoting a period or society characterized by an economy that is no longer based on heavy industry and manufacturing, but on services and information

words.tr:
n. 验尸；尸检；事后调查
adj. 死后的；死后发生的
words.ex: The doctor did a postmortem to find the cause of death.
words.ex_cn: 医生做了尸检以查明死因。
words.en: An examination of a dead body to determine the cause of death or the character and extent of changes produced by disease.

words.ex: He feels better after postoperative care.
words.ex_cn: 他在术后护理后感觉好多了。
words.en: relating to the period following a surgical operation

words.tr: n. 附言；附录；补充说明
words.ex: He added a postscript to his letter.
words.ex_cn: 他在信后加了一段附言。
words.en: A postscript is a note appended to a finished letter, article, or book.

words.ex: Bananas have a lot of potassium.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉含有大量的钾。
words.en: A soft silver-white reactive metal of the alkali metal group, occurring principally in the form of salts in seawater and in minerals such as sylvite and carnallite.

words.ex: This drug can potentiate the effect of painkillers.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物可以增强止痛药的效果。
words.en: To increase the power, effectiveness, or potency of something, especially a drug or a biochemical agent.

words.tr: adj. 盆栽的； v. “pot”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He bought a potted plant for his balcony.
words.ex_cn: 他为阳台买了一盆盆栽植物。
words.en: Potted plants are plants that are grown in pots rather than in the ground. Potted can also refer to something that is preserved or stored in a pot or similar container, or to a brief, simplified version of a story or explanation.

words.ex: Smallpox is a highly contagious pox.
words.ex_cn: 天花是一种高度传染性的痘症。
words.en: A pox is a disease characterized by pustules or eruptions on the skin, often associated with viruses.

words.tr: n. 实践者；从业者；执业者；
words.ex: He is a medical practitioner who helps patients every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位每天帮助病人的医疗实践者。
words.en: A practitioner is someone who works in a particular profession, especially one that requires special training and skills.

words.tr: n. 实用主义；务实思想
words.ex: He shows pragmatism by choosing the cheapest option.
words.ex_cn: 他选择最便宜的选项，体现了务实精神。
words.en: Pragmatism is a way of dealing with problems in a practical way rather than by following theories or principles.

words.ex: The cows graze on the prairie.
words.ex_cn: 牛在草原上吃草。
words.en: A prairie is a large area of flat, grassy land, especially in North America.

words.ex: He was precautious and checked the door before sleeping.
words.ex_cn: 他很有防备，睡觉前检查了门。
words.en: Being precautious means being careful to avoid possible danger or problems.

words.ex: The teacher gave precedence to students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师给早到的学生优先权。
words.en: If one thing takes precedence over another, it is regarded as more important than the other thing and is dealt with first.

words.tr: n. (尤指道德方面的)戒律；准则
words.ex: He follows the precept to be kind every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天遵循要善良的教诲。
words.en: A precept is a general rule intended to regulate behavior or thought.

words.ex: The bicycle was a precursor to the car.
words.ex_cn: 自行车是汽车的先驱。
words.en: A precursor is something that happened or existed before another thing, especially if it either developed into it or had an influence on it.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.ex: He found himself in a predicament when he lost his wallet.
words.ex_cn: 当他丢掉钱包时，他陷入了困境。
words.en: A predicament is a difficult, perplexing, or trying situation.

words.ex: He has a predilection for sweet food.
words.ex_cn: 他偏爱甜食。
words.en: If you have a predilection for something, you have a strong liking for it.

words.tr: v. 使预先有倾向；使易接受；使易于患（病）
words.ex: Genes can predispose a person to diabetes.
words.ex_cn: 基因可能使人更容易患糖尿病。
words.en: If something predisposes you to think or behave in a particular way, it makes it likely that you will think or behave in that way.

words.ex: He has a predisposition to catch colds easily.
words.ex_cn: 他容易感冒的倾向。
words.en: A predisposition is a tendency to behave in a particular way or to suffer from a particular condition.

words.ex: The cave paintings are prehistoric.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画是史前的。
words.en: Belonging to or existing in times before recorded history.

words.ex: He left school at 15, which was too premature.
words.ex_cn: 他15岁就离开了学校，这太早了。
words.en: Happening or done before the usual or expected time; not fully developed or mature.

words.ex: He is taking premedical courses to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他正在修读预医课程以成为一名医生。
words.en: Relating to the period of study undertaken by a student before entering medical school.

words.ex: The preponderance of evidence shows he is guilty.
words.ex_cn: 大多数证据表明他有罪。
words.en: If there is a preponderance of one type of thing or person in a group, there are more of that type than of any other.

words.ex: You need basic math as a prerequisite for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你学习这门课程的前提是掌握基础数学。
words.en: A prerequisite is something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen.

words.tr:
n. 预示；前兆；预感
v. 预示；预兆
words.ex: The dark clouds presage a storm.
words.ex_cn: 乌云预示着一场风暴。
words.en: If something presages a situation or event, it is considered to be a warning or sign of what is about to happen.

words.tr: adj. 预知的；有先见之明的
words.ex: His prescient warning saved many lives.
words.ex_cn: 他那有先见之明的警告挽救了许多生命。
words.en: Having or showing knowledge of events before they take place.

words.tr: adj. 规定的；指定的；约定俗成的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prescriptive rule for writing essays.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了一个关于写论文的规定性规则。
words.en: If something is prescriptive, it involves making rules or giving instructions about what should be done.

words.tr: n. 总统职位；总统任期
words.ex: He won the presidency in 2020.
words.ex_cn: 他在2020年赢得了总统职位。
words.en: The position or term of office of a president.

words.ex: Monkeys and apes are primates.
words.ex_cn: 猴子和猿类是灵长类动物。
words.en: A primate is a member of the most developed and intelligent group of mammals, which includes humans, apes, and monkeys. In a religious context, a primate can also refer to the chief bishop or archbishop in a province or country.

words.tr: adj. 原始的；远古的；最初的
words.ex: The primordial soup formed the first life on Earth.
words.ex_cn: 原始汤形成了地球上的最初生命。
words.en: Primordial means existing at or from the beginning of time; primeval.

words.ex: The prism splits sunlight into seven colors.
words.ex_cn: 棱镜将阳光分解成七种颜色。
words.en: A prism is a transparent optical element with flat, polished surfaces that refract light. At least two of the flat surfaces must have an angle between them. The exact angles between the surfaces depend on the application. The traditional geometrical shape is that of a triangular prism with a triangular base and rectangular sides, and in colloquial use 'prism' usually refers to this type.

words.ex: The forest remained pristine and untouched.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林保持原始且未被破坏。
words.en: Something that is pristine is in its original condition and has not been spoiled or damaged.

words.tr: n. 普鲁卡因（牙医等用的局部麻醉药）
words.ex: The dentist administered procaine to numb the area before starting the procedure.
words.ex_cn: 牙医在开始手术前给该区域注射了普鲁卡因以进行麻醉。
words.en: Procaine is a local anesthetic drug of the amino ester group. It is used primarily to reduce the pain of intramuscular injection of penicillin, and it was also used in dentistry.

words.ex: He has a proclivity for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有解决数学问题的倾向。
words.en: A proclivity is a natural tendency to behave in a particular way or to like a particular thing.

words.tr: n. （为军队或其他组织的）采购
words.ex: The army's procurement of food and fuel takes months.
words.ex_cn: 军队的食品和燃料采购需要数月时间。
words.en: Procurement is the act of obtaining or buying goods and services, often for a business or government.

words.tr:
v. 戳；刺；激励；督促
n. 戳；刺；催促
words.ex: He prodded the fire with a stick.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子戳了戳火。
words.en: To poke or jab someone or something, often with a finger or a pointed object, in order to get their attention or to encourage them to do something.

words.tr: adj. 惊人的；巨大的；奇异的；巨大的；
words.ex: He showed a prodigious memory for names.
words.ex_cn: 他对名字有着惊人的记忆力。
words.en: If you describe something as prodigious, you are emphasizing that it is very large or impressive.

words.ex: The boy is a piano prodigy at age six.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩六岁时就是一位钢琴奇才。
words.en: A prodigy is someone who is unusually young and has a great natural ability in a particular area.

words.ex: The prodrome of the flu includes symptoms such as fever and fatigue.
words.ex_cn: 流感的前驱症状包括发烧和疲劳。
words.en: A prodrome is an early symptom or set of symptoms that might indicate the start of a disease before specific symptoms occur.

words.tr: n. 预断病情；预后；预测
words.ex: The prognosis for patients with this disease is generally poor.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病的患者预后通常不佳。
words.en: A prognosis is an estimate of the future course and outcome of a disease, especially of the chances of recovery.

words.ex: The projectionist skillfully operated the film projector.
words.ex_cn: 电影放映员熟练地操作着放映机。
words.en: A projectionist is a person who operates a movie projector, especially in a cinema.

words.tr:
n. 脱垂；脱出；下垂
v. 下垂；脱垂
words.ex: The doctor advised surgery to correct the prolapse.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议手术以纠正下垂。
words.en: A prolapse is a medical condition in which an organ or part of the body slips forward or down out of its usual position.

words.tr: n. 推进剂；发射药；火箭燃料
words.ex: The rocket uses a strong propellant to fly.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用一种强大的推进剂来飞行。
words.en: A propellant is a substance that is used to move something forward, especially a rocket or a bullet, by creating a force that pushes it.

words.ex: He has a propensity for telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他有说实话的倾向。
words.en: A propensity is a natural tendency to behave in a particular way.

words.ex: The doctor recommended regular prophylaxis to prevent infections.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议定期进行预防以防止感染。
words.en: Prophylaxis refers to actions taken to prevent disease, especially by specified means or against a specified disease.

words.tr: n. 支持者；拥护者；辩护者
words.ex: He is a proponent of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 他是清洁能源的支持者。
words.en: A proponent of an idea or course of action is someone who supports it and tries to persuade other people to support it.

words.tr: n. 所有者；经营者 ；业主
words.ex: The proprietor runs a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 店主经营一家小咖啡馆。
words.en: A proprietor is a person who owns a particular type of business, especially a hotel, a shop, or a company.

words.ex: The rocket uses chemical propulsion to fly into space.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用化学推进力飞入太空。
words.en: Propulsion is the force that moves something forward, especially in vehicles like cars, planes, or spacecraft.

words.ex: The prospector searched for gold in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 矿工在山里寻找黄金。
words.en: A prospector is a person who searches for mineral deposits, especially by drilling and excavation.

words.ex: He visited the doctor for a prostate check.
words.ex_cn: 他去看医生做前列腺检查。
words.en: The prostate is a gland in the male reproductive system that is located just below the bladder and in front of the rectum. It surrounds the urethra, the tube through which urine and semen exit the body.

words.tr:
n. 卖淫者；娼妓；妓女；男妓
v. 卖淫；出卖（名誉等）；糟蹋自己；滥用才能
words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句
words.en: A prostitute is someone who engages in sexual activity for payment.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: The two countries signed a protocol to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项停止战争的协议。
words.en: A protocol is a set of rules or a system of rules about the correct way to act in formal situations.

words.ex: A proton has a positive charge.
words.ex_cn: 质子带正电。
words.en: A proton is a subatomic particle found in the nucleus of every atom. The particle has a positive electrical charge, equal and opposite to that of the electron.

words.ex: The cell contains protoplasm.
words.ex_cn: 细胞中含有原生质。
words.en: The colorless material comprising the living part of a cell, including the cytoplasm, nucleus, and other organelles.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.tr: adj. 突起的；凸出的；隆起的
words.ex: The dog has a protuberant belly.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的肚子凸出来。
words.en: Something that is protuberant sticks out from a surface in a noticeable way.

words.tr: adj. 机缘巧合的；及时的；凑巧的
words.ex: It was providential that he found the lost key.
words.ex_cn: 他找到丢失的钥匙真是幸运。
words.en: If you describe something as providential, you mean that it happens at exactly the right time, often by chance, and often in a way that is very fortunate.

words.tr: n. 地方主义；方言；偏狭性
words.ex: The author's use of provincialism adds authenticity to the story.
words.ex_cn: 作者使用方言增加了故事的真实性。
words.en: Provincialism refers to the attitudes, practices, and other characteristics of a province or of someone from a province, often implying a lack of sophistication or a narrow-minded perspective.

words.ex: He gave a pseudo answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个假的答案。
words.en: Not genuine; sham.

words.tr: n. 精神病学家；精神科医生
words.ex: He visits a psychiatrist every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去看一次精神科医生。
words.en: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who specializes in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illnesses and emotional disorders.

words.ex: He wants to study psychiatry after medical school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在医学院毕业后学习精神病学。
words.en: Psychiatry is the branch of medicine concerned with the study, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illness.

words.tr: adj. 精神的；灵魂的；心理的；通灵的；
words.ex: He has a psychic connection with his twin brother.
words.ex_cn: 他和双胞胎兄弟有精神上的联系。
words.en: Relating to or denoting faculties or phenomena that are apparently inexplicable by natural laws, especially involving telepathy or clairvoyance.

words.ex: He visits a therapist for psychoanalysis every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都去看心理医生做精神分析。
words.en: A method of treating mental disorders by investigating the interaction of conscious and unconscious elements in the mind and bringing repressed fears and conflicts into the conscious mind.

words.ex: The company used psychographic data to better understand their target audience.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用心理记录数据来更好地了解他们的目标受众。
words.en: Relating to the study and classification of people according to their attitudes, aspirations, and other psychological criteria, especially in market research.

words.tr: n. 精神病；精神错乱；思觉失调
words.ex: He showed signs of psychosis after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他表现出精神病的症状。
words.en: A severe mental disorder in which thought and emotions are so impaired that contact is lost with external reality.

words.ex: He entered puberty at age 12.
words.ex_cn: 他12岁时进入青春期。
words.en: Puberty is the stage in a person's life when they physically develop from a child into an adult.

words.ex: The dog stepped in a puddle.
words.ex_cn: 狗踩进了一个水坑。
words.en: A puddle is a small pool of liquid, especially of rainwater on the ground.

words.ex: The pueblo is old and has stone houses.
words.ex_cn: 这个普韦布洛很古老，有石屋。
words.en: A pueblo is a type of Indian village built by certain peoples in the south-western United States, especially one consisting of multistorey adobe houses built by the Pueblo people.

words.ex: He puffed after running up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他跑上楼梯后喘着气。
words.en: If you puff, you breathe in and out quickly and with force, for example because you have been running or because you are out of breath. A puff of something such as air or smoke is a small amount of it that is blown out from somewhere.

words.ex: He used a pulley to lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他用滑轮把箱子吊起来。
words.en: A pulley is a wheel with a grooved rim around which a cord passes. It acts to change the direction of a force applied to the cord and is chiefly used (typically in combination) to raise heavy weights.

words.tr: adj. 肺的；肺部的；与肺有关的
words.ex: He has a pulmonary infection.
words.ex_cn: 他患有肺部感染。
words.en: Relating to the lungs.

words.ex: The orange was squeezed into a sweet pulp.
words.ex_cn: 橙子被榨成了甜美的浆状物。
words.en: The soft, wet, shapeless mass of material that is left after the juice has been removed from fruit or vegetables, or the soft inner part of a tooth.

words.tr: v. 连续猛击；反复拳打；捶打
words.ex: The boxer pummels his opponent with fast punches.
words.ex_cn: 拳击手用快速的拳击击打他的对手。
words.en: To pummel someone or something means to hit them many times using your fists.

words.tr:
n. 清教徒；清教徒似的人；主张禁欲的人； 极端拘谨的人
adj. 清教徒的；主张禁欲的； 极端拘谨的
words.ex: He lives a puritan life, avoiding all pleasures.
words.ex_cn: 他过着清教徒般的生活，避免一切享乐。
words.en: A puritan is a person who follows strict moral or religious principles, especially one who is opposed to sensual pleasures.

words.ex: The wound became purulent after a few days.
words.ex_cn: 伤口几天后变得有脓。
words.en: Relating to, containing, or discharging pus.

words.ex: The wound has a lot of pus.
words.ex_cn: 伤口里有很多脓。
words.en: Pus is a thick yellowish or greenish opaque liquid produced in infected tissue, consisting of dead white blood cells and bacteria with tissue debris and serum.

words.ex: He wears pyjamas to bed every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上穿睡衣睡觉。
words.en: Pyjamas are loose-fitting clothes consisting of trousers and a jacket that people, especially men, wear in bed.

words.ex: The pylorus is the lower part of the stomach that connects to the small intestine.
words.ex_cn: 幽门是连接胃与小肠的下部。
words.en: The pylorus is the part of the stomach that connects to the duodenum, controlling the passage of partially digested food from the stomach to the small intestine.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: The patient showed signs of pyrexia.
words.ex_cn: 病人表现出发热的迹象。
words.en: An abnormal elevation of body temperature, usually as a result of a pathological process.

words.tr:
n. 嘎嘎叫声；庸医；冒充内行的人
v. 嘎嘎地叫；大声闲谈；冒充内行
words.ex: The duck made a loud quack.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子发出了响亮的嘎嘎叫声。
words.en: A quack is someone who pretends to have medical skills that they do not really possess. It can also refer to the sound a duck makes.

words.tr: n. 四分之一圆周；象限；四分仪
words.ex: The point lies in the first quadrant of the circle.
words.ex_cn: 这个点位于圆的四分之一圆周的第一象限。
words.en: A quadrant is one of the four equal parts into which a circle is divided by two lines that cross each other at right angles.

words.tr:
adj. 四边的；四边形的
n. 四边形
words.ex: The quadrilateral shape has four sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个四边的形状有四条边。
words.en: A quadrilateral is a polygon with four sides and four angles.

words.ex: The village has a quaint old church.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄有一座古色古香的古老教堂。
words.en: Something that is quaint is attractive because it is unusual and old-fashioned.

words.ex: He stayed in quarantine for 14 days.
words.ex_cn: 他隔离了14天。
words.en: A quarantine is a period of time during which an animal or person that might have a disease is kept away from other people or animals so that the disease cannot spread.

words.ex: The workers load stones from the quarry.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从采石场装载石头。
words.en: A quarry is a place where stone, sand, etc., is dug out of the ground. It can also refer to an animal or person that is being hunted or chased.

words.ex: The clock has a quartz crystal inside.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟里面有一个石英晶体。
words.en: Quartz is a hard, crystalline mineral composed of silicon and oxygen atoms. It is one of the most common minerals in the Earth's continental crust.

words.ex: The quasar is very far away and very bright.
words.ex_cn: 这个类星体非常遥远且非常明亮。
words.en: A quasar is a massive and extremely remote celestial object, emitting exceptionally large amounts of energy, and typically having a star-like image in a telescope.

words.ex: Quinine is used to treat malaria.
words.ex_cn: 奎宁用于治疗疟疾。
words.en: A bitter crystalline compound present in cinchona bark, used as a tonic and formerly to treat malaria.

words.ex: The doctor diagnosed him with quinsy and prescribed antibiotics.
words.ex_cn: 医生诊断他患有扁桃腺炎，并开了抗生素。
words.en: An abscess in the tissue around the tonsils, usually caused by bacterial infection and resulting in severe sore throat and difficulty in swallowing.

words.tr: n. 奇事；巧合；怪癖；奇行
words.ex: His habit of talking to his plants is a strange quirk.
words.ex_cn: 他跟植物说话的习惯是一个奇怪的奇事。
words.en: A quirk is a peculiar habit or aspect of a person's character, or an unexpected twist in a situation or story.

words.ex: The dog has rabies.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗得了狂犬病。
words.en: Rabies is a serious disease that affects the brain and nerves, usually caught from the bite of an infected animal.

words.tr:
n. 架子；支架；齿条；破坏
v. 折磨；使痛苦；放在架上；累计（得分）
words.ex: He put the books on the rack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars or hooks, that is used for holding things or for hanging things on. As a verb, to rack something means to cause great pain or suffering to someone.

words.ex: The radiator is hot in the winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，散热器是热的。
words.en: A radiator is a device for heating a room or building, consisting of a series of pipes through which hot water or steam is circulated. It can also refer to a device for cooling an engine or other mechanism, typically consisting of a bank of thin tubes with fins attached, through which coolant flows.

words.ex: The radicle is the first part of the plant to emerge from the seed.
words.ex_cn: 胚根是植物从种子中首先萌发出的部分。
words.en: The radicle is the part of a plant embryo that develops into the primary root.

words.ex: The radioactive material glows in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 这种放射性物质在黑暗中发光。
words.en: Something that is radioactive contains a substance that produces energy in the form of powerful and harmful rays.

words.tr:
n. X 光照
v. 拍 X 光线照片
words.ex: The doctor analyzed the radiograph to determine the extent of the injury.
words.ex_cn: 医生分析了X光片以确定受伤的程度。
words.en: A radiograph is an image produced by X-rays, used in medicine to view the internal structure of the body.

words.ex: He works in the radiology department at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院的放射科工作。
words.en: Radiology is the branch of medicine that uses medical imaging to diagnose and treat diseases within the body.

words.ex: She is undergoing radiotherapy for her cancer.
words.ex_cn: 她正在接受放射治疗以治疗癌症。
words.en: The treatment of disease, especially cancer, using X-rays or similar forms of radiation.

words.ex: The new policy has a wide radius of influence.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策的影响范围很广。
words.en: A straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere.

words.ex: He plays ragtime on the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他弹奏拉格泰姆音乐。
words.en: Ragtime is a type of music that was popular in the early 20th century, characterized by a syncopated melodic line and regularly accented accompaniment.

words.ex: He eats a raisin every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一粒葡萄干。
words.en: A raisin is a dried grape.

words.tr:
n. 耙子；耙地机
v. 用耙子耙；扫掠过；搜索
words.ex: He uses a rake to collect leaves.
words.ex_cn: 他用耙子收集树叶。
words.en: A rake is a garden tool consisting of a row of metal or wooden teeth attached to a long handle. You use a rake to make the earth level or to gather leaves together.

words.ex: The doctor detected rales in the patient's lungs during the examination.
words.ex_cn: 医生在检查时在患者的肺部听到了罗音。
words.en: A rale is an abnormal rattling sound heard when examining unhealthy lungs with a stethoscope.

words.ex: The decision will ramify into many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定将会引发许多问题。
words.en: To divide or spread out into branches or branchlike parts.

words.tr: adj. 泛滥的；猖獗的；蔓生的
words.ex: Rumors are rampant in the small town.
words.ex_cn: 谣言在这个小镇上四处流传。
words.en: If you describe something bad, such as a crime or disease, as rampant, you mean that it is very common and is increasing in an uncontrolled way.

words.ex: He works on a large ranch in Texas.
words.ex_cn: 他在德克萨斯州的一个大牧场工作。
words.en: A ranch is a large farm, especially in the western United States and Canada, where cattle or other animals are bred and raised.
